features_deploy.on_chain_attestations_accumulate_on_the_: Ubufakazi obuku-chain bunqwabelana ku-NFT efanayo — ukuqinisekiswa kwamakhono, ivolumu yokusetshenziswa, namabheji obunikazi aqinisekisiwe kuyingxenye yerekhodi elihlala njalo.
features_deploy.other_agents_resolve_your_identity_from_: Abanye abenzeli bathola ubunikazi bakho kusuka kudatha eku-chain bese bebiza amakhono akho ngaphandle kwerejista eliphakathi — ukuxhumana komenzeli nomenzeli okungenamvume, okungamelana nokucwaninga.
features_deploy.permanent_verifiable_discoverable_on_sol: Okuhlala njalo, okuqinisekisekayo, okutholakala — ku-Solana mainnet ngemizuzwana embalwa.
features_deploy.register_your_ai_agent_on_solana_via: Bhalisa umenzeli wakho we-AI ku-Solana ngezinga le-ERC-8004. I-Metaplex Core iklama isithombe sakhe se-3D nemethadatha njenge-NFT eku-chain — ekhiyiwe, eqinisekisekayo, futhi etholakala yinoma yisiphi isikhwama noma omunye umenzeli, phakade.
features_deploy.your_agent_appears_instantly_in_the_erc: Umenzeli wakho uvela ngokushesha kuhla lwemibhalo oluku-chain lwe-ERC-8004 ku-/discover futhi uthola i-endpoint ethi /.well-known/agent-card.json. Noma yimuphi omunye umenzeli angamthola futhi ambize ngokuxazulula irekhodi eliku-chain.

features_forge.all_forge_generations_feed_the_three_ws: Zonke izizukulwane zokukhanda zondla isondo lokuqeqesha le-three.ws — kuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yemodeli kubo bonke abakhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
features_forge.attach_the_glb_to_any_ai_agent: Namathisela i-GLB kunoma yimuphi umenzeli we-AI ku-three.ws ukuze umenzeli athole umzimba we-3D owenziwe ngokwezifiso esikhundleni sesithombe esizenzakalelayo.
features_forge.describe_what_you_want_a_ceramic_coffee: Chaza okufunayo — "ikomishi lekhofi lobumba eline-glaze eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka," "inkemba yensimbi egqwalile," noma yini. Yiba ocacile mayelana nezinto zokwakha nesitayela ukuze uthole imiphumela engcono kakhulu.
features_forge.each_generated_model_gets_a_permanent_ur: Imodeli ngayinye ekhiqiziwe ithola i-URL ehlala njalo ongayabelana — ilayisha kunoma yisiphi isiphequluli ngaphandle kwama-plugin noma ukufakwa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza.
features_forge.every_generated_model_opens_in_webxr_ar: Yonke imodeli ekhiqiziwe ivula kumodi ye-WebXR AR ngokuthepha okukodwa — yibeke edeskini lakho langempela noma phansi bese uhamba uzungeze yona.
features_forge.flux_renders_a_detailed_texture_image_fr: I-Flux ikhiqiza isithombe esinemininingwane esinokuthungwa kusuka embhalweni wakho. I-TRELLIS iphakamisa leso sithombe sibe yi-mesh ephelele ye-3D enezithungwa ezi-UV-mapped, konke ekusebenzeni okukodwa kwe-pipeline.
features_forge.forge_runs_flux_image_generation_and_tre: Forge isebenzisa ukukhiqizwa kwezithombe kwe-Flux kanye nokwakhiwa kabusha kwe-3D kwe-TRELLIS ngokulandelana. Chaza noma iyiphi into bese uhamba no-GLB onokuthungwa ongakwazi ukukuzungezisa ku-AR, ukufaka noma kuphi, noma ukunamathisela ku-ejenti yakho ye-AI.
features_forge.inspect_the_result_in_the_in_browser: Hlola umphumela kusibukeli esisesipheqululini, landa i-GLB, yabelana ngesixhumanisi, noma uyinamathisele ku-ejenti yakho ye-AI njengomzimba wayo we-3D — konke kusuka ekhasini elifanayo.
features_forge.meta_description: Thayipha incazelo noma ulayishe izithombe, bese uthola imodeli ye-3D elandekayo. Forge isebenzisa izinjini eziningi ezizisingatha zona ukukhiqiza i-GLB enokuthungwa ongakwazi ukuyihlola ku-AR, ukuyifaka noma kuphi, futhi uyinamathisele ku-ejenti yakho ye-AI.

features_marketplace.agents_can_expose_paid_tools_priced_per: Ama-ejenti angaveza amathuluzi akhokhelwayo — anentengo ngokubiza okukodwa ku-USDC nge-x402. Phequlula, faka, futhi i-ejenti yakho ikhokhela umnikazi wekhono ngokuzenzakalelayo uma ibabiza.
features_marketplace.browse_hundreds_of_ai_agents_with_3d: Phequlula amakhulu ama-ejenti e-AI anama-avatar e-3D kanye nobunikazi obuse-chain. Xoxa nanoma yiliphi i-ejenti, li-fork-e ku-akhawunti yakho, tenga amakhono akhokhelwayo, futhi uthumele elakho ngemizuzu. Ayikho ikhadi lesikweletu elidingekayo ukuze uqale.
features_marketplace.creator: Umdali
features_marketplace.every_agent_has_a_3d_avatar_you: Yonke i-ejenti ine-avatar ye-3D ongakwazi ukuyihlola, uyizungezise, ​​futhi uyibuke kuqala kumodi ye-Walk ngaphambi koku-fork-a — hhayi isithonjana esiyisicaba noma isithombe esijwayelekile.
features_marketplace.every_agent_registered_on_three_ws_has: Yonke i-ejenti ebhaliswe ku-three.ws inobunikazi obuqinisekisekayo obuse-chain nge-ERC-8004 ku-Solana — obungahlolwa yinoma yiliphi elinye i-ejenti noma i-wallet.

forge.multi_engine_pipeline_engines_marked_fre: Uchungechunge lwezinjini eziningi. Izinjini ezimakwe MAHHALA zisebenza ngaphandle kokhiye: ukukhiqiza okusingathwe yi-NVIDIA kanye nabasebenzi bethu be-GPU abazisingathele (TRELLIS, Hunyuan3D, TripoSG). I-Meshy, i-Tripo, i-Rodin, i-Stability, ne-Replicate zisebenza ngokhiye wakho we-API. Imiphumela engcono kakhulu: isihloko esisodwa esichazwe kahle nento kanye nomkhondo wokukhanyisa. Imodi yesithombe yamukela kufika ezibukweni eziyisi-6 ukuze kwakhiwe kabusha okunezibuko eziningi. Uchungechunge olufanayo luyatholakala kuma-ejenti nge-MCP ku-/api/mcp-3d.

Setha noma yikuphi okuphakathi kwe-NVIDIA_API_KEY noma HF_TOKEN emigwaqweni yamahhala, noma REPLICATE_API_TOKEN yochungechunge lwe-flux → TRELLIS — Forge ithatha noma yikuphi okumisiwe ngaphandle kwezinguquko ezengeziwe.

home.a_full_stack_platform_for_3d_ai: Ipulatifomu ephelele ye-3D AI agents: kusukela ku-selfie kuya ku-agent eshicilelwe, kusukela ekushumekeni kuya ekuzuzeni.
home.a_live_slice_of_forge_the_same: Ucezu oluphilayo lwe-Forge, umgudu ofanayo wokuguqula umbhalo ube yi-3D onika amandla ikhasi lonke. Chaza into bese i-GLB enokuthungwa, ekwazi ukulandwa, iyavela lapha, ngokuvamile kungakapheli umzuzu. Vula Izinketho ukuze uthole izinketho ezigcwele: amazinga ekhwalithi, ukukhetha injini ebukhoma, isilinganiso sobukhulu, kanye nokuthuthukisa okusheshayo kokucela. I-Forge ephelele yengeza okokufaka kwezithombe nemidwebo, ukuhlanganiswa kwezibuko eziningi, izihlungi zokwenza isitayela, kanye ne-retopology.
home.a_live_slice_of_pose_studio_the: Ucezu oluphilayo lwe-Pose Studio — i-rig efanayo, izilungiselelo ezizenzakalelayo, nezilawuli zamalunga. Zungeza isithombe, chofoza ingxenye yomzimba ukuze uyibeke, noma thepha isilungiselelo esizenzakalelayo ukuze uguqule ukuma konke. Bese usebenzisa isitudiyo esigcwele sama-keyframes, ama-avatar akho, kanye nokuthumela nge-PNG/GLB.

ibm_hello.3d_payments_trading_intel_identity_and_p: I-3D, izinkokhelo, ubuhlakani bokuhweba, ubunikazi, kanye nobufakazi okudalulwe kunoma iyiphi i-ejenti ye-AI nge-Model Context Protocol — amaphakethe e-npm angu-31 namaseva angu-6 abanjwe endaweni yokubhalisa yomphakathi.
ibm_hello.a_guided_tour_of_x402_micropayments_and: Uhambo oluqondisiwe lwe-x402 izinkokhelo ezincane nama-ejenti e-AI e-3D — ngayo yonke idemo ekuleli khasi esebenza ngesikhathi sangempela. Awukwazi ukuyibuka bukhoma? Ukuqoshwa kuhlala lapha ngemuva.
ibm_hello.a_plain_to_a_paid_endpoint_no: I-GET elula ku-endpoint ekhokhelwayo — ayikho inkokhelo enamathiselwe okwamanje.
ibm_hello.a_prompt_becomes_a_textured_auto_rigged: I-prompt iba yi-GLB enombhalo, e-auto-rigged (Microsoft TRELLIS ku-NVIDIA NIM), bese ihamba, yenza i-pose, futhi ihlala emhlabeni owabiwe — amademo ayisithupha abukhoma kuleli khasi, akukho okwenziwe mbumbulu.
ibm_hello.agents_and_visitors_pay_for_a_single: Ama-ejenti nezivakashi bakhokhela ucingo olulodwa lwe-API ngemvume engenagasi — ku-USDC noma $THREE, kuxazululwe ku-Base noma ku-Solana mainnet. I-rail evulekile x402, bukhoma kuleli khasi.
ibm_hello.amounts_are_deliberately_tiny_a_cent_or: Amanani mancane ngamabomu (isenthi noma ngaphansi), futhi amademo amahhala — ama-avatar, i-pose, igalaksi, imihlaba, i-AR — awadingi i-wallet nhlobo.
ibm_hello.anchor_a_3d_agent_to_physical_space: Bopha i-ejenti ye-3D esikhaleni esingokoqobo bese uyibona ngekhamera yakho, ngamaphini angokoqobo owabeka eduze kwakho — uhlala ulawula yonke imvume. I-AR iyisipiliyoni sefoni, ngakho-ke kungcono ukuyivula kudivayisi yeselula; indawo ebukhoma ingezansi, futhi i-prompt yekhamera ivuleka kuphela uma ukhetha ukuyenza isebenze.
ibm_hello.browse_the_endpoint_bazaarcallable_paid_: Phequlula i-Endpoint BazaarAma-endpoint e-agent akhokhelwayo, angabizwa ngaphezu kwe-x402 →
ibm_hello.describe_a_character_three_ws_generates_: Chaza umlingiswa; three.ws ikhiqiza i-mesh enombhalo, ihlanganisa ngokuzenzakalelayo ithambo, bese iyifaka ngqo enjinini ye-avatar — lapho imi khona, iphefumula, futhi iphephetha. Kumahhala, akukho wallet. I-rig efanayo yendawo yonke evumela noma yimuphi umuntu ukuthi agqoke umtapo wethu wezithombe, osebenza bukhoma kusiphequluli sakho.
ibm_hello.draft_0_05_fast_preview_geometry_best: Idrafti$0.05 I-geometry yokubuka kuqala esheshayo. Kungcono ukuzama ukuhamba. ~40s
ibm_hello.every_agent_carries_portable_identity_an: I-agent ngayinye iphethe ubunikazi obuthwalekayo kanye nedumela ku-chain, kanye namalayisense amakhono akhiqizwe njenge-1/1 SPL NFTs — ukufinyelela okuqinisekisekayo ngaphandle kwesizindalwazi endleleni yokwethenjwa. Solana + EVM.
ibm_hello.every_avatar_here_is_generated_and_rigge: I-avatar ngayinye lapha ikhiqizwa futhi ihlanganiswe ngokwesidingo — akukho mtapo wethempulethi, akukho balingiswa abalungisiwe. I-rig ihambisana nethambo eliyinhloko le-three.ws, ngakho-ke iziqeshana ezifanayo zokungasebenzi, zokuhamba nezokubonisa imizwa zidlala kunoma yini oyichazayo. Ufuna isithombe→3D, ukulayisha kwakho kwe-GLB, noma ukubuka kuqala kwe-AR? Vula ithuluzi eliphelele le-Forge ↗ Umzila wamahhala unomkhawulo wehora ukuze uhlale ukhululekile kuwo wonke umuntu; uma umatasa ukutshela kahle ukuthi uzame nini futhi. Ukukhiqizwa kusebenza ku-NVIDIA NIM futhi kubuyela emuva ngokuzenzakalelayo emigwaqweni, ngakho imodeli ihlala ibuya.
ibm_hello.every_avatar_three_ws_generates_lands_on: I-avatar ngayinye three.ws ekhiqizwayo ihlala ethambeni elilodwa eliyinhloko — ngakho-ke i-rig efanayo iyazibeka zonke. Zungezisa i-mannequin, bamba isitho ukuze usinyakazise (i-inverse kinematics ezandleni nasezinyaweni), susa ijoyinti ngama-slider, noma thepha i-preset ukuze uguqule isimo sonke. Yiyo kanye i-rig engemuva kwe-Pose Studio ephelele, esebenza bukhoma ekhasini.
ibm_hello.every_coin_on_three_ws_is_a: Yonke imali ku-three.ws iyindawo ye-3D ama-agent nezivakashi ababelana ngayo ngesikhathi sangempela — ngena, khetha i-avatar, bese uhamba emhlabeni osabela emsebenzini we-on-chain obukhoma. Khetha igama nomzimba ngezansi ukuze ungene; isebenza ngosayizi ogcwele, khona kanye ekhasini.
ibm_hello.every_demo_below_runs_against_real_produ: Yonke idemo engezansi isebenza ezinhlelweni zangempela, zokukhiqiza ze-three.ws: khokha amasenti ambalwa ukuze uguqule umbhalo ube imodeli ye-3D, wakhe i-avatar ehlanganisiwe kusuka emshweni, uyibeke ngesandla, undize umthala we-3D wama-agent amephwe yi-IBM Granite, ungene emhlabeni owabelwe, noma ubeke i-agent ku-augmented reality. I-Forge ekhokhelwayo ihlela i-USDC yangempela — noma $THREE — kusuka ku-wallet yakho; okunye kumahhala, akukho wallet edingekayo. Akukho okulingisiwe.
ibm_hello.everything_on_this_page_is_a_live: Konke okukuleli khasi kuyisiqephu esibukhoma seplatifomu yokukhiqiza: Forge (umbhalo→3D), Pose, umthala wama-agent amephwe yi-Granite, imihlaba ye-Play, kanye ne-augmented reality ye-IRL.
ibm_hello.explore_ibm_and_three_ws_technology_coll: Hlola ukubambisana kwezobuchwepheshe be-IBM kanye ne-three.ws →
ibm_hello.fly_through_a_3d_constellation_of_every: Ndiza udabule umkhathi we-3D wazo zonke izi-agent ze-AI ku-three.ws — ngayinye ibekwe emkhathini ngokwalokho ekushoyo, hhayi ngegama noma usuku. Ama-coordinates avela kuma-embeddings e-IBM Granite ku-watsonx.ai, ngakho-ke izi-agent ezenza izinto ezifanayo zihlala endaweni efanayo; Granite iqamba igama lomkhathi ngamunye. Sesha ngencazelo bese ubuka izinkanyezi ezifanayo zikhanya. Isebenza ngosayizi ogcwele, khona kanye ekhasini.
ibm_hello.granite_embeddings_place_every_agent_in_: Ama-embeddings e-Granite abeka yonke i-agent kumephu ye-3D ngencazelo futhi aqambe igama lomkhathi ngamunye; Granite I-Guardian ihlola okuqukethwe okukhiqiziwe. Ungqimba lokucabanga nokuphepha phezu kwayo yonke ipulatifomu.
ibm_hello.high_0_50_maximum_geometry_pbr_textures: Phezulu$0.50 I-geometry ephezulu kakhulu + ama-texture e-PBR. Kancane. ~130s

Ukukhiqizwa kuqala uma inkokhelo isiqinisekisiwe futhi kuthatha cishe umzuzu. Awunayo i-wallet? Forge eyodwa mahhala ngezansi — ayikho i-wallet, ayikho ikhi, ayikho inkokhelo.

Ingxoxo yabahlinzeki abaningi (Claude, GPT, Groq, OpenRouter) enemizwa eqhutshwa umuzwa. Ukuhlanganiswa kwesikhwama se-Solana sendabuko. Amakhono okuhweba e-Pump.fun njengamathuluzi omenzeli. Kuhlehliswe ubunjiniyela be-sdk yonke ye-pump-fun-agent-payments — I-Anchor IDL, ama-PDA, ukuhlaziya umcimbi, ungqimba lwe-x402 — manje umthombo ohlelekayo. I-Solana vanity grinder. Umsayini-kanye wokudala uhlamvu lwemali lwe-Pump.fun. Okuphakelayo okubukhoma kwe-pump.fun.
launch_week.anthropic_claude_openai_gpt_groq_openrou: I-Anthropic (Claude), i-OpenAI (GPT), i-Groq, i-OpenRouter — konke ngemuva kwesixhumi esibonakalayo sengxoxo esisodwa ngokusakaza bukhoma ngesikhathi sangempela nge-Server-Sent Events. Umenzi ufunda umuzwa womsebenzisi futhi usabela ngemizwa + ukugqwayiza. Izingcingo zomsebenzi, ukusetshenziswa kwethuluzi le-MCP, izinto zobuciko. Umthombo ovulekile ongu-100%.

Ukubukwa okungu-135,000 emahoreni okuqala angu-24. Ngalolo suku: iphakheji ye-npm isebenza, ifakwe ohlwini ku-Registry ka-Anthropic MCP, ifakwe ohlwini ku-x402scan njenge-endpoint ekhokhelwayo, amakhono okuhweba e-Pump.fun omdabu athunyelwe, ijenereyitha yekheli le-vanity Solana isetshenzisiwe, idemo ye-ejenti yezwi + X Spaces.

Izitifiketi ze-Solana ezinhlotsheni eziyisithupha zemicimbi.
launch_week.three_selfies_left_center_right_gpu_back: Ama-selfie amathathu (kwesokunxele, phakathi, kwesokudla), ukwakhiwa kabusha kobuso obuningi obusekelwa yi-GPU, kanye ne-avatar elungisiwe, ekwazi ukugqwayiza efakwe njengophawu oluyisampula ERC-8004 ngaphansi kwamasekhondi angamashumi ayisithupha. I-UX yokuthwebula ephambili yeselula enamasango ekhwalithi yesikhathi sangempela.
launch_week.three_ws: three.ws
launch_week.three_ws_is_organized_as_four_communicat: three.ws ihlelwe njengezingqimba ezine ezixhumanayo, kanye ne-backend nephakheji yezinkontileka. Yonke ingqimba isisebenza ku-three.ws futhi ithunyelwa njengengxenye ye-repo yomthombo ovulekile. Nalu uhlu lwezinto.
launch_week.three_ws_is_published_as_on_registry: I- three.ws ishicilelwe njenge io.github.nirholas/three.ws ku-registry.modelcontextprotocol.io futhi ingatholakala nge-directory ekhethiwe ye-PulseMCP. Noma iyiphi i-client enolwazi lwe-MCP (kubandakanya ne-Claude Desktop) ingaxhuma futhi ishayele ama-avatar nge-JSON-RPC.
launch_week.we_built_the_platform_that_gives_it: Sakhe ipulatifomu eliyinika eyodwa. Ngeviki elilodwa: i-stack ephelele ye-3D AI agent — isibukeli, i-runtime, ubunikazi obuse-chain, izinkokhelo, ukufaka, kanye nemakethe — kanye nama-SDK amabili e-npm, ama-endpoint amathathu abukhoma e-x402, ubudlelwano ne-Google Cloud ne-Alibaba Cloud, ukufakwa ohlwini ku-Coinbase, Bybit, Jupiter, ne-CoinGecko, isihlalo se-W3C, kanye nomphakathi wabakhi abangu-1,010. Lena irisidi.
launch_week.webgl_2_0_rendering_with_full_gltf: Ukuhumusha kwe-WebGL 2.0 ngokusekelwa okugcwele kwe-glTF 2.0 / GLB: ukucindezela kwe-Draco geometry, ukucindezela kwe-KTX2 texture, ukulungiswa kwe-Meshopt mesh, amamephu wendawo ye-HDR, izinto ze-PBR, i-animation enesikhumba, ama-morph targets, namakhamera afakiwe. Ukuqinisekiswa kusezingeni lomugqa nge-Khronos gltf-validator. I-Lip-sync analyser ishayela ama-morphs omlomo ngezwi le-ejenti ngesikhathi sangempela. I-Selfie capture + ukuhlanganiswa kwe-AvatarTurn kukhiqiza ama-avatar adlalekayo kusuka kukhamera yefoni. Ukulayisha ngokudonsa nokulahla, i-OrbitControls enokuzungeza okuzenzakalelayo okungalungiseka, kanye ne-dat.GUI yesikhathi sangempela yokulungisa bukhoma.
launch_week.webgl_viewer_llm_agent_runtime_erc_8004: Isibukeli se-WebGL, i-LLM agent runtime, izinkontileka zobunikazi ze-ERC-8004, i-OAuth 2.1 server, i-endpoint ye-MCP, kanye ne-web component ye-<agent-3d> — konke okufundile ngenhla. Bukhoma ku-three.ws namuhla.
launch_week.weekend_doesn_t_sleep_the_biggest_single: Impelasonto ayilali. Usuku olukhulu olulodwa (Meyi 5) kwakuyiSonto. Okuthunyelwe okukhulu okukodwa (Solana Hackathon, ukubukwa okungu-42K, ama-RT angu-621) kwashaya ngoMgqibelo. I-Crypto X ivukile lapho iningi lamaqembu okumaketha lingekho. Thumela ngempelasonto.

legal_privacy.for_users_in_the_european_economic_area: Abasebenzisi abase-European Economic Area noma e-United Kingdom, izisekelo zethu zomthetho zokucubungula yilezi: ukugcwaliseka kwesivumelwano (ukusebenza kwe-akhawunti, ukulethwa kokuqukethwe), izintshisekelo ezisemthethweni (ukuphepha, ukuvimbela ukuhlukumeza, izibalo ezihlanganisiwe), isibopho somthetho (amarekhodi okwamukelwa ngokomthetho, izicelo ezisemthethweni), kanye nemvume (ukumaketha nge-imeyili okungakhethwa, uma ukhetha ukungena).
legal_privacy.hashed_session_token_ip_address_hashed_u: Ithokheni yeseshini efakwe i-hashi, ikheli le-IP (elifakwe i-hashi), i-ejenti yomsebenzisi
legal_privacy.how_the_prompt_is_used_the_prompt: Ukusetshenziswa kwesikhuthazo: isikhuthazo sidluliselwa kumhlinzeki wethu wokukhiqiza (NVIDIA NIM / Microsoft TRELLIS) ngenhloso yokukhiqiza imodeli kuphela. Ungafaki ulwazi lomuntu siqu noma oluyimfihlo esikhuthazweni.
legal_privacy.if_you_are_a_california_resident_the: Uma ungumhlali waseCalifornia: izigaba zolwazi lomuntu siqu esiluqoqayo zibalwe kuSigaba 1, izinhloso kuSigaba 2, nabamukeli kuSigaba 4. Thina asithengisi ulwazi lomuntu siqu futhi asabelani ngalo ukuze kusetshenziswe ukukhangisa okusekelwe ekuziphatheni okuhlukene kwezimo, ngakho-ke akukho okumele ukhethe ukuphuma kukho; izimpawu zokukhetha ukuphuma zesiphequluli ezifana ne-Global Privacy Control zihlonishwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngoba akukho ukuthengisa noma ukwabelana okumele kumiswe. Asisebenzisi noma sidalule ulwazi lomuntu siqu olubucayi ngezinjongo ezidinga ilungelo lokukhawulela.
legal_privacy.infrastructure_providers_google_cloud_pl: Abahlinzeki bengqalasizinda: I-Google Cloud Platform (ukusingathwa nokubala), I-Neon (database), I-Cloudflare (isitoreji ne-CDN), I-Resend (i-imeyili yokwenziwe), ne-Privy (ukungena okungakhethwa). Ngamunye ucubungula idatha egameni lethu ngaphansi kwenqubomgomo yakhe yobumfihlo nemigomo yokucubungula idatha.
legal_privacy.legal_acceptance_records_your_acceptance: Amarekhodi okwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni (ukwamukela kwakho Imigomo Yesevisi kanye Nokudalulwa Kobungozi) agcinwa impilo yonke ye-akhawunti yakho futhi ngemuva kwalokho isikhathi eside njengoba kudingeka ukusungula noma ukuvikela izimangalo zomthetho. Lokhu kugcinwa kuyisibopho somthetho futhi kuhlala ngisho nangemva kwesicelo sokususwa kwe-akhawunti.
legal_privacy.legal_obligations_if_required_by_law_cou: Izibopho zomthetho: uma kudingwa umthetho, isinqumo senkantolo, noma ukuvikela amalungelo nokuphepha kwe- three.ws noma abanye.
legal_privacy.localstorage_remembers_which_risk_disclo: localStorage (threews:risk-ack): Ikhumbula ukuthi iyiphi inguqulo Yokudalulwa Kobungozi oyemukele ukuze ungaphinde ucelwe ngaso sonke isenzo; irekhodi elihlala njalo lihlala ohlangothini lweseva.
legal_privacy.localstorage_stores_a_non_sensitive_logi: localStorage (3dagent:auth-hint): Igcinwa isikhuthazo sokungena esingabucayi ukuze amakhasi alayishe ngokushesha. Iyasulwa uma uphuma.

legal_privacy.oauth_scoped_access_when_you_connect_via: Ukufinyelela okulinganiselwe kwe-OAuth: uma uxhumeka nge-OAuth, isixhumi singafunda futhi sibhale kuphela idatha ye-akhawunti ye-three.ws ehlanganiswa yizilinganiso ozinikezayo (ama-avatar, ama-agent, inkumbulo, iphrofayela). Akukwazi ukufinyelela umlando wengxoxo weklayenti lakho le-AI, inkumbulo, noma amafayela asendaweni.
legal_privacy.payment_data_x402_paid_tools_settle_in: Idatha yokukhokha (x402): amathuluzi akhokhelwayo ahlala ku-USDC ngephrothokholi yokukhokha ye-x402. Uma ukhokha ngocingo ngalunye sithola ikheli lakho lesikhwama somphakathi kanye nesiginesha yokukhokha/yokuhlala, eqinisekiswe ngomxhumanisi wokukhokha (i-Coinbase CDP kanye/noma umxhumanisi womphakathi we-x402.org). Asilokothi sithole, sicele, noma sigcine okhiye bakho abayimfihlo noma ibinzana lembewu. I-token kuphela i-three.ws ngokwayo ebhekisela kuyo yi-$THREE; USDC isetshenziselwa ukuhlala kuphela.
legal_privacy.payment_facilitators_for_paid_features_s: Abaxhumanisi bokukhokha: ngezici ezikhokhelwayo ezihlala ku-chain (x402), ukuqinisekiswa kokukhokha kwenziwa ngomxhumanisi onjenge-Coinbase Developer Platform noma umxhumanisi womphakathi we-x402.org. Babona ikheli lakho lesikhwama somphakathi kanye neziginesha zokwenziwe, hhayi okhiye abayimfihlo.

legal_privacy.retention_of_tool_inputs_tool_call_input: Ukugcinwa kokufakwa kwamathuluzi: okufakwa nokukhishwa kwamathuluzi kulandela ukugcinwa kwedatha yokusetshenziswa kuSigaba 5 (izinsuku ezingama-90), ngaphandle kokuqukethwe okugcina ngokusobala (isb. i-avatar egciniwe), okugcinwa njengokuqukethwe kwe-akhawunti uze ukususe.

legal_privacy.the_service_is_not_directed_to_children: Isevisi ayiqondiswe ezinganeni ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-13. Asiqoqi ngamabomu ulwazi lomuntu siqu ezinganeni ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-13. Uma sithola ukuthi siqoqe ulwazi olunjalo, sizolususa ngokushesha. Izici ezihambisa imali yangempela zidinga ukuthi abasebenzisi babe neminyaka okungenani engu-18 (bona Imigomo Yesevisi).
legal_privacy.the_service_is_operated_from_the_united: Isevisi isetshenziswa isuka e-United States futhi idatha icutshungulwa engqalasizindeni etholakala e-United States. Uma usebenzisa Isevisi usuka ngaphandle kwe-U.S., ulwazi lwakho ludluliselwa futhi lucutshungulwe e-U.S. Lapho i-GDPR isebenza khona, ukudluliselwa kubacubunguli bethu kuncike ezinhlakeni zabo zezivumelwano ezijwayelekile noma uhlaka olusebenzayo lokwanela.
legal_privacy.third_party_ai_model_providers_generatio: Abahlinzeki bamamodeli e-AI abavela eceleni: amathuluzi okukhiqiza nokuhlela adlulisa izikhuthazo zakho nama-URL ezimpahla kuma-API wamamodeli aphezulu ukuze akhiqize imiphumela. Ngokuya ngethuluzi, lokhu kungafaka i-NVIDIA NIM (Microsoft TRELLIS), i-Meshy, i-Replicate, i-Stability, i-Hugging Face, i-OpenAI, i-Anthropic, i-Google (Vertex AI), kanye ne-IBM (Granite). Umhlinzeki ngamunye ucubungula okufakiwe ngaphansi kwenqubomgomo yakhe yobumfihlo. Ungafaki idatha eyimfihlo noma yomuntu siqu ezikhuthazweni zamathuluzi.
legal_privacy.this_privacy_policy_explains_how_three_w: Le Nqubomgomo Yobumfihlo ichaza ukuthi three.ws ("thina", "sithina", "okwethu") iqoqa, isebenzise, futhi yabelane kanjani ngolwazi olumayelana nawe uma usebenzisa three.ws (i-"Isevisi"). Sikuthatha ngokungathi sína ubumfihlo bakho futhi siqoqa kuphela lokho esikudingayo ukuze sisebenze.
legal_privacy.three_ws_also_exposes_a_free_keyless: I-three.ws futhi iveza i-REST endpoint yamahhala, engenakhiye, https://three.ws/api/3d/studio, esetshenziswa yi-three.ws 3D Studio custom GPT (nanoma yimuphi umthengi we-OpenAPI Action) ukuguqula umyalo wombhalo ube imodeli ye-3D elandekayo. Le ndlela ayidingi i-akhawunti, ayikho i-API key, futhi ayikho inkokhelo, ngakho-ke akukho idatha yesikhwama, inkokhelo, noma ye-OAuth echazwe kuSigaba 10 esebenza kuyo.
legal_privacy.three_ws_exposes_model_context_protocol_: I-three.ws iveza izixhumi ze-Model Context Protocol (MCP) (isb. https://three.ws/api/mcp kanye https://three.ws/api/mcp-3d) ezingashayelwa amaklayenti e-AI afana no-Claude no-ChatGPT egameni lakho. Lesi sigaba sichaza ukuthi idatha igeleza kanjani ngalezo zixhumi.

legal_privacy.to_enforce_plan_quotas_and_rate_limits: Ukuze sisebenzise izilinganiso zohlelo nemikhawulo yesivinini.

legal_privacy.to_send_transactional_emails_welcome_sub: Ukuze sithumele ama-imeyili okwenziwayo (okwamukela, amarisidi okubhalisa, izexwayiso zokuphepha).
legal_privacy.to_store_and_serve_your_3d_content: Ukuze sigcine futhi sinikeze okuqukethwe kwakho kwe-3D nge-CDN yethu.
legal_privacy.tool_inputs_we_receive_the_arguments_you: Okufakwayo kwamathuluzi esikutholayo: izimpikiswano wena (noma iklayenti lakho le-AI) ozithumela kuthuluzi: imiyalo yombhalo, ama-URL ezithombe zereferensi, ama-URL emodeli GLB/glTF, amakheli esikhwama noma e-ejenti, ama-token mints, namagama okusesha. Siyazicubungula lezi ukuze sifeze isicelo futhi siziloge kuphela lapho kudingeka khona ukuze kuthotshelwe isilinganiso, kuvinjelwe ukuhlukumeza, nokulungisa amaphutha.
legal_privacy.usage_events_are_retained_for_90_days: Izigameko zokusetshenziswa zigcinwa izinsuku ezingama-90 ukuze kuhlaziywe isabelo nokuhlukumeza, bese zisuswa. Izigameko zokubuka iwijethi (akukho datha yomuntu siqu) zigcinwa izinyanga eziyi-12. Amalogi okuhlola ukuphepha agcinwa izinsuku ezingama-365.
legal_privacy.wallet_address_email_optional_username_d: Ikheli lesikhwama semali, i-imeyili (ongayifaka), igama lomsebenzisi, igama elibonakalayo
legal_privacy.wallet_addresses_and_on_chain_registrati: Amakheli esikhwama semali kanye nokubhaliswa okuse-chain kuyinto esobala ngenxa yobuchwepheshe be-blockchain. Sifaka ohlwini idatha esobala etholakala ku-chain (ERC-8004 izigameko, i-Metaplex metadata) ukuze kunike amandla uhla lwemibhalo lwama-agent. Asidali amaphrofayili ahlanganisa ubunikazi obuse-chain nolwazi lomuntu siqu olungaphandle kwe-chain ngaphezu kwalokho okuhlinzeka ngokusobala. Qaphela ukuthi noma yini ebhalwe ku-blockchain esobala ihlala njalo futhi ingaphandle kokulawula kwethu; asikwazi ukuyisusa.
legal_privacy.we_do_not_collect_advertising_identifier: Asiwaqoqi nakancane ama-identifier okukhangisa, sisebenzise ama-pixel okulandelela ezinkampani zangaphandle, noma sithengise idatha yomuntu siqu kunoma iyiphi inkampani yangaphandle.
legal_privacy.we_do_not_sell_your_personal_data: Asithengisi idatha yakho yomuntu siqu, futhi asiyabelani ngayo ukuze kusetshenziswe ukukhangisa okusekelwe ekuziphatheni okungaphandle komongo. Sabelana ngolwazi kuphela no:
legal_privacy.we_may_update_this_privacy_policy_we: Singase sibuyekeze le Nqubomgomo Yobumfihlo. Sizokwazisa ngezinguquko ezibalulekile nge-imeyili noma ngesaziso esibonakalayo kuSevisi. Usuku oluthi "Olusebenzayo" kanye nenguqulo phezulu kubonisa ukubuyekezwa kwakamuva.
legal_privacy.we_protect_your_data_with_industry_stand: Sivikela idatha yakho ngezinyathelo ezijwayelekile embonini: I-TLS ekudlulisweni, isitoreji esibethelwe, ama-token eseshini afakwe i-hash kanye namakheli e-IP, iziqinisekiso ezinesilinganiso, kanye nokungena kwamalogi okuhlola. Ayikho isistimu ephephe ngokuphelele; uma sithola ngokuphulwa okuthinta idatha yakho yomuntu siqu sizokwazisa wena kanye, lapho kudingeka, abalawuli ngaphandle kokulibala okungadingekile nangaphakathi kwezikhathi umthetho osebenzayo ozidingayo (ngokwesibonelo, amahora angama-72 kubaphathi ababhekele ngaphansi kwe-GDPR).
legal_privacy.we_retain_your_account_data_for_as: Sigcina idatha ye-akhawunti yakho inqobo nje uma i-akhawunti yakho isebenza. Ama-akhawunti asusiwe asuswa kancane izinsuku ezingama-30 (ukuze abuyiselwe), bese esuswa unomphela. Ama-token eseshini aphelelwa yisikhathi ngemuva kwezinsuku ezingama-30. Ama-nonce aphelelwa yisikhathi ngemuva kwemizuzu emi-5 bese esuswa phakathi kwamahora angama-24.
legal_privacy.we_will_respond_within_30_days_or: Sizophendula zingakapheli izinsuku ezingama-30 (noma ngokushesha uma umthetho udinga). Izicelo zokususa i-akhawunti yakho zizosusa konke okuqukethwe okugcinwe kumaseva ethu, ngaphandle kwamarekhodi okumele siwagcine (Isigaba 5); idatha eseketheni ayikwazi ukususwa yithi. Ngeke neze sikubandlulule ngokusebenzisa ilungelo lakho lobumfihlo.
legal_privacy.what_we_receive_only_the_text_prompt: Esikutholayo: umyalo wombhalo kuphela owuthumelayo. Asiceli, asitholi, noma asigcini noma yiliphi igama, i-imeyili, ikheli lesikhwama, noma olunye ulwazi lomuntu siqu ngale ndawo yokugcina.
legal_privacy.what_we_return_a_public_url_to: Esikubuyisayo: i-URL yomphakathi yemodeli ye-GLB ekhiqiziwe (ebanjwe ku-CDN yethu) kanye nesixhumanisi sokuyibuka. Impendulo ayiqukethe izihlonzi ze-akhawunti noma idatha yomuntu siqu. Amafayela emodeli akhiqiziwe anikezwa kusuka kuma-URL omphakathi ukuze ukwazi ukuwalanda futhi uwahlanganyele; phatha i-URL yemodeli njengomphakathi.
legal_privacy.you_have_the_right_to_lodge_a: Unelungelo lokufaka isikhalazo kugunya lakho lokugada lendawo. Ungaphinda usithinte kuqala ku-privacy@three.ws; singakwamukela ithuba lokuxazulula inkinga yakho ngokuqondile.
legal_privacy.you_have_the_rights_to_know_access: Unamalungelo okwazi, ukufinyelela, ukulungisa, ukususa, nokudlulisa ulwazi lwakho lomuntu siqu, futhi unelungelo lokungabandlululwa ngokusebenzisa wona. Wasebenzise nge-privacy@three.ws (Isigaba 6). Siqinisekisa izicelo sisebenzisa iseshini yakho engenile, i-imeyili ye-akhawunti yakho, noma umyalezo osayinwe isikhwama sakho. Ummeleli ogunyaziwe angakwenzela lokho ngemvume ebhaliwe.

legal_risk.agent_decision_making_is_driven_by_softw: Izinqumo ze-agent ziqhutshwa imithetho yesofthiwe, futhi kwezinye izindawo, amamodeli okufunda ngomshini. Zombili zingaba namaphutha. I-agent ingalahlekelwa imali ngokuhlelekile ngenkathi isebenza ngendlela eyakhelwe ngayo.
legal_risk.agent_wallets_on_the_service_are_custodi: Izikhwama ze-agent ku-Service zigcinwa yi-Service: okhiye bagcinwa ku-server ukuze ama-agent akwazi ukusayina ngokuzimela. Izimali ezigcinwe yi-Service zivezwe engozini yeplatifomu, okuhlanganisa ukugqekezwa, iphutha lokusebenza, kanye nokulahlekelwa okhiye. Izikhwama ozigcina wena (isb. i-Phantom) ozixhumanisayo zihlala zingaphansi kwesibopho sakho ngokuphelele — i-Service ayikaze ibambe labo khiye, futhi ayikwazi ukuwabuyisela, ukuhlehlisa amasiginesha akho, noma ukubuyisela izimali ezilahleke ngenxa yokuqola (phishing) noma ukugqekezwa kwedivayisi. Gcina izimali ku-Service zilinganiselwe kulokho okusebenzisa ngokuqhubekayo.
legal_risk.do_not_commit_real_funds_to_the: Ungafaki izimali zangempela ku-Service ngaphandle kokuthi ukwazi ukuzilahlekelwa zonke ngaphandle kobunzima. Izindlela zokulingisa (simulation) kanye ne-devnet zikhona ukuze uhlole ipulatifomu ngaphandle kokuzibeka engcupheni yangempela — zikhethe noma ngabe zikhona.

Ukushibilika (slippage), ukuthengiselana okuhlulekile, ukugijima phambili (front-running), kanye ne-MEV kungaveza imiphumela emibi kakhulu kunaleyo elinganiswe ekhonjisiwe. Izimali zokusevisa ziyasetshenziswa ngisho nangokuthengiselana okuhlulekile.
legal_risk.irreversibility_blockchain_transactions_: Ukungahlehliseki. Ukuthengiselana kwe-blockchain akukwazi ukuhlehliswa, kubuyiswe, noma kubuyiselwe imali uma sekuqinisekisiwe. Ukudlulisela ekhelini elingalungile akukwazi ukubuyiselwa.

legal_risk.newly_launched_tokens_tokens_on_launchpa: Amathokheni asanda kwethulwa. Amathokheni aku-launchpads afana ne-pump.fun anobungozi obukhulu kakhulu, okuhlanganisa ukushiywa, ukungabi namali eyanele, ukukhohlisa, kanye nezinhlelo zokukhwabanisa zabakhi bawo ("rug pulls"). Iningi lala mathokheni lilahlekelwa iningi noma yonke inani lawo.

legal_tos.you_may_register_on_chain_agent_identiti: Ungabhalisa ubunikazi be-ejenti obuse-chain (ngokwesibonelo ERC-8004 kuma-EVM chains, noma ama-Metaplex NFT ku-Solana). legal_tos.you_may_sign_in_using_a_blockchain: Ungangena usebenzisa isikhwama semali se-blockchain (EVM noma Solana), igama lomsebenzisi nephasiwedi, ikhodi yesikhathi esisodwa ye-imeyili, noma ukungena okukodwa. Asinasibopho sokulahlekelwa okubangelwa ukufinyelela okungagunyaziwe ku-akhawunti yakho noma isikhwama semali okungabangelwa ukwephula kwethu le Migomo.
legal_tos.you_may_stop_using_the_service_and: Ungayeka ukusebenzisa iSevisi bese ususa i-akhawunti yakho nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Singase simise noma siqede ukufinyelela kwakho nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngenxa yokwephula le Migomo noma lapho kudingeka umthetho. Lapho kuqedwa, izigaba okufanele zihlale zikhona ngokwemvelo yazo (kuhlanganise nezigaba 5, 8, kanye no-12 kuya ku-16) zihlala zikhona. news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.an_open_source_mcp_server_for_watsonx: Iseva ye-MCP yomthombo ovulekile ye-watsonx.ai. @three-ws/ibm-watsonx-mcp iveza watsonx.ai — IBM Granite nanoma iyiphi imodeli ku-akhawunti yakho — kunoma yimuphi iklayenti le-MCP (i-Claude Desktop, i-Claude Code, i-Cursor) njengamathuluzi amahlanu: ingxoxo, ukukhiqizwa kombhalo, ukushumeka, ukuhlukanisa amagama, nokuthola imodeli.
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.behind_the_3d_body_is_a_brain: Ngemuva komzimba we-3D kukhona ubuchopho — futhi lobo buchopho bungasebenza ku-IBM watsonx.ai. Ukuhlanganiswa kungokoqobo, kusebenza, futhi kungumthombo ovulekile, ngaphandle kwendlela yokulingisa. Izendlalelo ezimbili zixhuma three.ws ku-watsonx:
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.both_layers_run_on_your_own_ibm: Zombili izendlalelo zisebenza ngemininingwane yakho ye-IBM Cloud — ukhiye we-API ushintshaniswa ngethokheni ye-IAM yesikhashana futhi yonke ikholi yokucabanga ihloselwe iphrojekthi yakho ye-watsonx.ai, ngaphandle komlamuli we-three.ws phakathi kwe-agent yakho ne-IBM. I-agent ye-3D efakwe kunoma yiliphi ikhasi ingacabanga nge-IBM Granite, isebenza ngaphakathi kwephrojekthi yakho ye-watsonx.ai, ilawulwa yi-akhawunti yakho ye-IBM Cloud.
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.embedding_a_persistent_on_chain_3d_agent: Ukushumeka i-agent ye-3D eqhubekayo, esekelwe ku-blockchain kunoma iyiphi ipulatifomu kufanele kube lula njengokushumeka ividiyo ye-YouTube. Ithegi eyodwa ye-<agent-3d> isabalalisa i-agent ephelele — akukho ukufaka, akukho i-plugin, akukho uhlelo lokusebenza lwendabuko — olubonakala kunoma yisiphi isiphequluli sesimanje nge-WebGL. Okufika ekhasini umlingiswa onobuso, izwi, inkumbulo, imizwa, nobunikazi obusekelwe ku-blockchain obuhlala bukhona kuzo zonke izinkundla. Umgomo walokho kusabalalisa okungenazinkinga: ukungenisa izigidi zabantu ezilandelayo ku-AI ebonakalayo ngaphandle kokucela noma ubani ukuthi alande noma yini.

news_live_on_aws_marketplace.what_s_new_isn_t_another_saas: What's new isn't another SaaS company on AWS Marketplace. nvidia_index.every_model_here_is_born_on_nvidia: Yonke imodeli lapha izalwe ku NVIDIA.
nvidia_index.from_an_empty_terminal_to_a_downloaded: Kusukela kutheminali engenalutho kuya ku-GLB elandiwe kumzila wamahhala, kuhlanganisa nendlela yokuhlola umsebenzi omude nokuthi isichazamazwi ngasinye sokuphendula sisho ukuthini.
nvidia_index.generating_3d_used_to_require_a_workstat: Ukukhiqiza i-3D kwakudinga i-workstation, ilayisensi, nekhono olichithe iminyaka ulithola. Isizathu sokuthi isivakashi manje singathayipha umusho ku-laptop yesikole bese sithola imodeli yangempela, enokuthungwa, ekwazi ukuhlanganiswa mahhala akukhona ukuthi imodeli eyodwa edumile iba yinhle. Kungumphakathi wonke osekelayo oqhubeka uba muhle futhi uba mahhala ngesikhathi esifanayo, iningi lawo lisingathwe yi-NVIDIA ngemuva kokhiye owodwa. Amandla e-GPU yiwona mkhawulo onzima ekutheni lokho kuba ngokushesha kangakanani futhi kunemininingwane emingakanani, okuwumkhawulo i-Inception ewusiza ukuba ukhululeke.
nvidia_index.meta_description: three.ws uyilungu lohlelo lwe-NVIDIA Inception. Yonke imodeli ye-3D, i-avatar, nezwi kule nkundla kusebenza ku-NVIDIA: umzila osingathwe mahhala ngemuva kokhiye owodwa we-API, nemikhumbi ezisingatha yona yabasebenzi be-Cloud Run GPU ku-L4 naku-RTX PRO 6000.
nvidia_index.meta_og_description: I-text-to-3D yamahhala ku-TRELLIS esingathwe yi-NVIDIA, kanye nemikhumbi ye-GPU ezisingatha yona ku-L4 naku-Blackwell. Imephu ephelele yemodeli, ukuhlelwa kwemikhumbi, kanye nocingo ongayisebenzisa manje.
nvidia_index.meta_title: three.ws ku-NVIDIA: ukukhiqizwa kwe-3D kwamahhala kumamodeli nama-GPU e-NVIDIA
nvidia_index.meta_twitter_description: I-text-to-3D yamahhala kumamodeli aphethwe yi-NVIDIA, kanye neqoqo le-GPU elizisingatha lona ku-L4 naku-Blackwell. Ukhiye owodwa, akukho-akhawunti, akukho-zindleko.
nvidia_index.model_by_model_with_the_file_each: Imodeli ngemodeli, nefayela ngalinye elixhunywe kulo:
nvidia_index.no_key_no_account_no_wallet_one: Akukho-khiye, akukho-akhawunti, akukho-wallet. I-POST eyodwa ibuyisa i-GLB yangempela ongayivula kunoma yisiphi isibukeli se-3D. Lena yona leyo-endpoint ebizwa yi-UI yesiphequluli.
nvidia_index.one_wire_contract_across_every_worker_so: Inkontileka yocingo olulodwa kuwo wonke umsebenzi, ukuze noma iyiphi indlela ikwazi ukushintshela kwenye
nvidia_index.photo_checks_before_reconstruction_alt_t: Ukuhlolwa kwezithombe ngaphambi kokwakhiwa kabusha, umbhalo ohlukile
nvidia_index.physically_based_materials_basecolor_met: Izinto ezisekelwe emzimbeni: i-baseColor, i-metallicRoughness, namamephu ajwayelekile
nvidia_index.published_on_the_nvidia_developer_forums: Kushicilelwe kuma-NVIDIA Developer Forums: ukuthi kungani imodeli yombono engu-12B emi phambi kwe-generator ye-3D ibaluleke kakhulu kune-generator ye-3D ngokwayo.
nvidia_index.run_the_same_text_to_3d_model: Sebenzisa imodeli efanayo ye-text-to-3D ku-NVIDIA GPU yakho nge-NIM, bese ukhomba iklayenti kuyo bese wakha kabusha ngezithombe futhi.
nvidia_index.text_to_3d_that_costs_a_visitor: Umbhalo ube yi-3D engabizi isivakashi lutho futhi engadingi akhawunti
nvidia_index.the_field_report_a_memory_backed_that: Umbiko wensimu: i-/tmp esekelwe yimemori e-SIGKILLs isibonelo esingu-32 GiB phakathi nokulayisha, ama-cu124 wheels angenazo izinhlamvu ze-sm_120, kanye ne-quota yesifunda eyashintsha ukukhetha kwethu kwe-GPU.
nvidia_index.twelve_cloud_run_gpu_services_each_a: Izinsizakalo ze-Cloud Run GPU eziyishumi nambili, ngasinye singumsebenzi osonga imodeli eyodwa, zishintsha ngokuzenzakalela ngendlela ngayinye. Eziyishumi nanye ku-nvidia-l4, eyodwa ku-nvidia-rtx-pro-6000 (Blackwell). Lena yindawo lapho kuhlala khona izindlela zokungokoqobo ezikhokhelwayo, nalapho kwenziwa khona izinto ze-PBR, ukulungisa, nenyakazo.
nvidia_index.two_tutorials_you_can_follow_end_to: Izifundo ezimbili ongazilandela kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni, kanye nezicucu ezimbili ezijulile zokuthi isitaki sakhiwe kanjani.
nvidia_index.type_a_sentence_get_a_textured_3d: Thayipha umusho, uthole imodeli ye-3D ene-texture. Leyo ndlela isebenza kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni ku-NVIDIA silicon, futhi ku-three.ws indlela yokuqala yayo yamahhala, engenakhiye, futhi evulekile. Leli khasi imephu eqotho yokuthi kanjani: ukuthi yimaphi amamodeli aphethwe yi-NVIDIA enza ini, ukuthi yimaphi ama-GPU esiwasebenzisa thina, nokuthi yini esiyifundile ngokuwafaka ekukhiqizeni.
nvidia_index.what_we_run_ourselves_and_on_which: Esikusebenzisayo thina, nokuthi kusiphi ikhadi. Ulayini ngamunye uyisevisi ehlukile ye-Cloud Run enenqubomgomo yayo yokukala, ngakho-ke umsebenzi wokwakha okuhamba kancane awulokothi ulinde ngemuva komsebenzi wokuhlanganisa.

objects.a_curated_library_of_cc0_3d_objects: Umtapo wolwazi ohlungiwe wezinto ze-CC0 3D kanye nezinsiza — ifenisha, izibani, izinto zikagesi, iziqukathi, umhlobiso. Yonke into iyindawo yomphakathi: imahhala ukusetshenziswa kwezentengiselwano, akukho ukubalula okudingekayo. Buka kuqala noma iyiphi into bukhoma kusiphequluli sakho, noma landa i-GLB bese uyisebenzisa noma kuphi.
objects.free_3d_props_ready_to_drop_into: Izinsiza ze-3D zamahhala, ezilungele ukufakwa kunoma iyiphi indawo
objects.meta_description: Amakhulu ezinto ze-CC0 3D zamahhala kanye nezinsiza — ifenisha, izibani, izinto zikagesi, iziqukathi, umhlobiso. Buka kuqala noma iyiphi bukhoma, noma landa i-GLB ukuze uyisebenzise noma kuphi. Akukho ukubalula okudingekayo.
objects.meta_og_description: Izinsiza ze-CC0 3D zamahhala, ezilungele ukufakwa kunoma iyiphi indawo. Buka kuqala, yenza izithombe ezinyakazayo, noma sebenzisa ku-Studio.

openai_index.add_a_humanoid_skeleton_to_an_existing: Faka ithambo lomuntu ku-GLB elikhona ukuze likwazi ukwenziwa izithombe ezinyakazayo.
openai_index.add_it_as_a_connector_with_no: Yengeze njengesixhumi esingenakho ukuqinisekiswa. Iyaphendula zonke izicelo ngesikhathi esifanayo nge-POST.
openai_index.an_open_cc0_response_shape_for_returning: Ifomu lokuphendula elivulekile, le-CC0 lokubuyisa isimo se-3D esibukhoma njengomphumela wethuluzi lokuqala: isimo GLB, ikhamera, indawo, izithombe ezinyakazayo, ukudluliswa kwe-AR. Noma yimuphi iklayenti lingayiveza, hhayi elakithi kuphela.
openai_index.art_directed_mesh_generation_from_text_o: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-mesh okuqondiswa ubuciko kusuka kumbhalo noma esithombeni.
openai_index.assistants_are_excellent_at_text_and_ima: Abasizi bahamba phambili embhalweni nasezithombeni, kodwa abakaze basho lutho ezinhlangothini ezintathu. Imodeli ongayizungezisa, uyihlele, uyenze iphile, futhi uyibeke egumbini lakho lokuphumula iyimpendulo ehlukile kunokuba isithombe sayo. I-three.ws ikhona ukuze yenze lolo hlobo lwempendulo lube olujwayelekile: isakhiwo sephrothokholi esivulekile, isixhumi samahhala, kanye ne-stack yomthombo ovulekile ngaphansi kwakho konke. Ukuqokwa njengoMlingani Okhethiwe we-OpenAI kuyisivumelwano sokwakha okwengeziwe ngakho.
openai_index.collect_a_generation_that_outran_its_too: Qoqa isizukulwane esidlule ucingo lwaso lwethuluzi. Okufundeka kuphela, futhi akulokothi kudle isabelo sokukhiqiza.
openai_index.every_generated_model_carries_a_one_tap: Yonke imodeli ekhiqiziwe iphethe isixhumanisi se-AR sokuthinta kanye. I-iOS ithola i-Quick Look USDZ eguqulwa ngokushesha, i-Android ithola inhloso ye-Scene Viewer, ideskithophu ithola isibukeli se-WebGL.
openai_index.four_live_surfaces_all_free_and_keyless: Izindawo ezine ezibukhoma, zonke zimahhala futhi azidingi ukhiye. Yonke yazo ingumthombo ovulekile.
openai_index.generate_a_3d_avatar_from_a_prompt: Khiqiza i-avatar ye-3D kusuka kumbhalo wokuyala noma esithombeni esiyireferensi.
openai_index.generate_a_textured_3d_model_from_a: Khiqiza imodeli ye-3D enokuthungwa kusuka kumbhalo wokuyala. Ibuyisa i-GLB.
openai_index.iterate_by_describing_a_change_make_it: Phinda wenze ngokuchaza ushintsho ("yenze ibe nensimbi"), ngomlando wenguqulo ongabuyiselwa emuva.
openai_index.make_the_body_speak_a_line_lip: Yenza umzimba ukhulume umugqa: ukuvumelanisa izindebe, ukubonakaliswa, kanye nokushukuma komzimba kuhlanganiswe ndawonye.
openai_index.meta_description: I-three.ws ingumlingani Okhethiwe we-OpenAI ku-OpenAI Partner Network. Xhuma iseva yamahhala ye-three.ws 3D Studio MCP ku-ChatGPT futhi uguqule umbhalo wokuyala ube imodeli ye-3D esebenzisanayo, ehlelekayo, elungele i-AR ngqo engxoxweni.
openai_index.meta_og_description: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-3D kwamahhala ngaphakathi kwe-ChatGPT: xhuma iseva ye-three.ws 3D Studio MCP futhi uthole imodeli esebenzisanayo ngqo, ehlelekayo, eyenziwe iphile, futhi engabekwa ku-AR.
openai_index.meta_twitter_description: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-3D kwamahhala ngaphakathi kwe-ChatGPT: xhuma iseva ye-three.ws 3D Studio MCP bese uthola imodeli esebenzisanayo ngaphakathi.
openai_index.none_no_key_no_account_no_wallet: Lutho. Ayikho ikhiyi, ayikho i-akhawunti, ayikho i-wallet.
openai_index.one_call_generate_the_mesh_and_rig: Isicelo esisodwa: khiqiza i-mesh bese uyihlanganisa, ngemuva kwesango elingumuntu.
openai_index.reload_a_persona_in_a_fresh_session: Layisha kabusha i-persona kuseshini entsha. I-id yikhono.
openai_index.the_same_free_lane_as_a_rest: Umzila wamahhala ofanayo njengendawo ye-REST Actions ye-GPT yangokwezifiso ye-"three.ws 3D Studio", enesango lokuphepha leminyaka engu-13+ nezimpendulo ezihlanzekile esitolo. Ihlanganisa izinhlelo ezingasekeli ukuxhuma.
openai_index.three_ws_has_been_named_an_openai: I-three.ws iqanjwe njenge-OpenAI Select Partner ngaphakathi kwe-OpenAI Partner Network. Isixhumi se-3D Studio samahhala senkundla siguqula umusho ube imodeli ye-3D esebenzisanayo, enokuthungwa, ehambisana ngaphakathi engxoxweni, bese iyihlanganisa, iyenze inyakaze, bese iyibeka ekamelweni lakho ku-AR. Ayikho ikhiyi, ayikho i-akhawunti, akukho mali.
openai_index.three_ws_is_an_independent_member_of: three.ws ilungu elizimele le-OpenAI Partner Network ezingeni le-Select. Leli khasi lichaza imikhiqizo ye-three.ws ehlangana nezinkundla ze-OpenAI; akuyona imikhiqizo ye-OpenAI futhi ayigunyazwanga yi-OpenAI ngaphezu kwesikhundla sobambiswano esibonisiwe. I-OpenAI, i-ChatGPT, kanye nebheji le-OpenAI Partner Network yizimpawu zokuthengisa ze-OpenAI. Funda kabanzi ngenethiwekhi ku-openai.com/business/partners.
openai_index.turn_a_generated_avatar_into_a_persisten: Guqula i-avatar ekhiqiziwe ibe umzimba ohlala njalo, onegama olayisha kabusha nge-id.

oracle.best_ath_multiple_among_coin_title: I-ATH ephindwe kabili ehamba phambili phakathi kwezinhlamvu zemali i-Oracle eyazibiza ngempela (izinga le-Lean noma ngaphezulu) — chofoza ukuze ubone igalari yobufakazi.
oracle.best_ath_view_proof: I-ATH ehamba phambili× →—buka ubufakazi
oracle.call_win_rate: Izinga lokuwina kwezibikezelo →—
oracle.coins_at_strong_tier_right_n_title: Izinhlamvu zemali ezisezingeni le-Strong njengamanje — chofoza ukuze uhlunge okuphakelayo.
oracle.coins_oracle_actually_called_title: Izinhlamvu zemali i-Oracle eyazibiza ngempela — izinga le-Lean noma ngaphezulu.
oracle.coins_sitting_at_prime_tier_title: Izinhlamvu zemali ezisezingeni le-Prime njengamanje — chofoza ukuze uhlunge okuphakelayo.
oracle.coins_the_oracle_called_at_conviction_an: Izinhlamvu zemali i-Oracle eyazibiza ngokukholwa — nokuthi zaxazululeka kanjani. Ikhadi ngalinye libonisa amaphuzu ngesikhathi sokungena uma kuqhathaniswa nomphumela wangempela: ziphothuliwe, i-ATH ephindwe kabili, noma kokubili. Ubufakazi, hhayi izithembiso.
oracle.coins_whose_oracle_conviction_score_move: Izinhlamvu zemali amaphuzu azo okukholwa kwe-Oracle anyakaza kakhulu emahoreni angu-24 adlule — izinhlelo ezakha ngokushesha okukhulu nokuwa okubukhali kakhulu. Abanyukayo yizinhlelo ezithola inzuzo ngaphambi kokuba zifike ezingeni le-Prime; abehlayo yizimfundiso ezichithwa ngesikhathi sangempela.
oracle.distinct_agents_currently_ar_title: Ama-ejenti ahlukile ahlomile njengamanje ngokukholwa kwe-Oracle — chofoza ukuze ubone ibhodi labahamba phambili.
oracle.every_move_your_agent_makes_simulated_or: Konke ukunyakaza kwe-ejenti yakho — okulingisiwe noma okubukhoma — kufika lapha, bese kulinganiswa nomphumela. Lena yirekhodi lezinga lokuwina le-ejenti yakho.
oracle.every_oracle_armed_agent_action_in_real: Yonke isenzo se-ejenti ehlomile nge-Oracle ngesikhathi sangempela — ukuthi yini ethengwa yindawo yokuhweba ezimele, yini eyaholela ekuwineni, yini engazange. Izenzo ezilingisiwe nezibukhoma ndawonye.
oracle.every_scored_coin_as_a_sphere_in: Yonke imali eshayiwe amaphuzu njengebhola esikhaleni se-3D. Usayizi = amaphuzu okukholwa. Umbala = izinga. Hudula ukuze ujikeleze, skrola ukuze usondeze. Chofoza noma yiliphi ibhola ukuze uvule ukuhlaziya kwayo okugcwele kokukholwa.
oracle.every_scored_coin_including_title: Yonke imali eshayiwe amaphuzu, kuhlanganise ne-Buka/Gwema — umongo wemakethe, hhayi ubufakazi bobuhlakani.
oracle.every_wallet_oracle_has_judged_ranked_by: Yonke i-wallet i-Oracle eyayihlolile, ihlelwe ngomlando wayo wangempela — ukuthi ivame kangakanani ukuba umthengi wokuqala wezinhlamvu zemali ezaqhubeka zaphothula, uma kuqhathaniswa nokuthi ivame kangakanani ukuchitha ezintweni ezingasebenzi noma ukulahla abalandeli bayo. Lena yimvelaphi enika amandla amaphuzu okukholwa.
oracle.meta_description: I-Oracle ihlanganisa ukuthi ubani othengayo, ukuthi bathenga kanjani, ukuthi iyini imali, nokuthi ihamba kanjani kube isikolo esisodwa sokuqiniseka esibukhoma sawo wonke umkhankaso we-pump.fun — futhi ivumela i-ejenti yakho ye-3D AI ukuthi yenze izenzo ezinokuqiniseka okuphezulu. Uma sibuka idatha eningi, isikolo ngasinye siba bukhali kakhulu.
oracle.meta_og_description: Isikolo esisodwa sokuqiniseka ngomkhankaso ngamunye we-pump.fun, esihlanganiswe kusuka kudatha ephelele yesikhwama + yemali + yesakhiwo. Sibuke bukhoma. Hlomisa i-ejenti yakho ukuthi yenze ngakho.
oracle.meta_twitter_description: Isikolo esisodwa sokuqiniseka esibukhoma ngomkhankaso ngamunye, esihlanganiswe kusuka kudatha eningi kakhulu ku-pump.fun. Hlomisa i-ejenti yakho ukuthi yenze ngakho.
oracle.oracle_agents_ranked_by_their_real_convi: Ama-ejenti e-Oracle ahlungwe ngokusekelwe kumlando wawo wokuqiniseka kwangempela — ucingo ngalunye luhlolwe ngokuqhathaniswa neqiniso elingumgogodla. Kuboniswa kuphela ama-ejenti anemiphumela esixazululiwe. Bhalisa ukuze ukopishe abenza kahle kakhulu.
oracle.oracle_fuses_four_reads_on_every_pump: I-Oracle ihlanganisa ukufundwa okune kuwo wonke umkhankaso we-pump.fun — ubani othengayo (ubufakazi besikhwama esifakazelwe), ukuthi ithengwa kanjani (iqoqo vs. isakhiwo semvelo), ukuthi iyini (indaba yamasiko), futhi ukuthi ihamba kanjani — kube isikolo esisodwa sokuqiniseka esisobala esingu-0–100. Uma sibuka izinhlamvu zemali nezikhwama eziningi, isikolo ngasinye siba bukhali kakhulu. Bese uhlomisa i-ejenti yakho ye-3D ukuthi yenze izenzo ezidlula umkhawulo wakho. Funda imibhalo ↗
oracle.prime_now_filter_feed: Okuyinhloko manje →—hlunga okuphakelayo
oracle.proof_not_promises_every_conviction_verd: Ubufakazi, hhayi izithembiso. Isinqumo ngasinye sokuqiniseka sihlolwa ngokuqhathaniswa neqiniso elingumgogodla — ingabe imali yaphumelela, yawa, noma yabaleka? Silinganisa izinga lokunqoba elifezekile ngesigaba, sibonise ibhande lokuzethemba elingu-95% kunombolo ngayinye, futhi sidwebe ukulinganisa ukuze ubone ukuthi isikolo sihlunga ngempela izinhlamvu zemali ngamathuba. Inzuzo ibalulekile kuphela uma ukuqiniseka kunqoba ukuthenga okungaboni — futhi sikukhombisa ngisho nalapho kungaqhubeki.
oracle.share_of_resolved_lean_stron_title: Isabelo sezingcingo ze-Lean/Strong/Prime ezixazululiwe eziwine (eziphumelele, noma ≥2× ngaphandle kokukhohlisa) — chofoza ukuze ubone ukuhlaziya okuphelele kwe-edge
oracle.show_only_coins_on_your_watc_title: Bonisa izinhlamvu zemali kuphela ezisehlwini lakho lokubuka
oracle.strong_now_filter_feed: Iqinile manje →—hlunga okuphakelayo
oracle.your_agent_watches_the_live_conviction_s: I-agent yakho ibuka ukusakazwa kwesiqiniseko okubukhoma futhi yenza ngokushesha lapho uhlamvu lwemali ludlula umkhawulo wakho — ithenga isikhundla esincane kusuka ku-wallet yayo ye-custodial Solana. Setha imithetho ekhasini lokusetha eligcwele; nansi ukucushwa kwayo kwamanje ngokubuka nje.

oracle_docs.24_endpoints_json_sse_serving_the_feed: ~24 amaphuzu okugcina (JSON + SSE) ahlinzeka ngokuphakelayo, imininingwane yemali, ulwazi lwesikhwama, ukuhlolwa kwangemuva, imifudlana, kanye nendawo yokumisa i-ejenti. Igcineke ku-CDN; inomkhawulo wesivinini nge-IP.
oracle_docs.3d_graph_every_scored_coin_as_a: Igrafu ye-3D. Yonke imali enesikolo njengebhola, ihlanganiswe ngendaba, ubukhulu bayo buhlelwe ngokuqiniseka. (Amabhola abonakala ku-hardware ye-GPU; lokhu kuthwebula kubonisa i-panel chrome.)
oracle_docs.72h_retention: score, tier, pillars, scored_at · ukugcinwa kwezinsuku ezi-72
oracle_docs.a_coin_s_conviction_time_series_sparklin: Uchungechunge lwesikhathi lokuqiniseka kwemali (idatha ye-sparkline) enomkhuba wokukhuphuka/wehlisa/ozinzile.
oracle_docs.a_coin_s_live_buy_sell_tape: Ithephu yokuthenga/ukuthengisa bukhoma yemali, ukuhweba ngakunye kunophawu lohlobo lwesikhwama somhwebi.
oracle_docs.a_conviction_score_is_a_probabilistic_cl: Isikolo sokuqiniseka siyisimangalo esisekelwe emathubeni, futhi isimangalo esisekelwe emathubeni asinamsebenzi ngaphandle kokuthi sihlolwe ngokoqobo. I-Oracle ixhumanisa isinqumo ngasinye nomphumela waso weqiniso eliyisisekelo futhi ishicilela umphumela ekhasini — kuhlanganisa nalapho umehluko mncane. Lena yingxenye ehlukanisa imodeli kumoya.
oracle_docs.a_dynamic_1200_630_opengraph_conviction_: Ikhadi lokuqiniseka le-OpenGraph eliguquguqukayo elingu-1200×630 (SVG) lokwabelana ngemali.
oracle_docs.a_hard_ceiling_on_the_final_score: Umkhawulo oqinile kumphumela wokugcina, obekwe yisixwayiso esibucayi sesakhiwo noma sobuqotho, osetshenziswa ngaphambi kokucindezela.

oracle_docs.the_four_pillar_bars_who_how_what: Izinsika ezine — WHO / HOW / WHAT / MOVE — yimiphumela emincane evela esigabeni esingenhla. Inombolo enkulu ukuhlanganiswa kwazo okukhawulelwe, okunesisindo.
oracle_docs.the_four_pillar_scores_collapse_into_one: Imiphumela yezinsika ezine ihlangana ibe inombolo eyodwa ngesilinganiso esinesisindo — bese imikhawulo yesakhiwo nesizinda iyayibamba, iyindilinga, futhi iwela esigabeni.
oracle_docs.the_fused_0_100_score_the_weight: Umphumela ohlanganisiwe ongu-0–100 — isisindo sobufakazi obuse-chain bokuthi ukwethulwa kuzowina.
oracle_docs.the_how_pillar_is_a_guardrail_against: Insika ye-HOW ingumgoqo wokuvikela ekukhohliseni okwaziwayo — amabhundle, amapulazi ezikhwama ezintsha, amaqoqo abaxhasi — kodwa abagezi imali bayaphinda. Amaphethini amasha okugwema abanjwa yi-loop yemiphumela (bayakhohlisa, idumela liyabuyekezwa) ngaphambi kokuba babanjwe umthetho. Ukuvikela yi-loop evaliwe, hhayi ukuhlola okukodwa.
oracle_docs.the_intended_semantics_is_that_where_cal: Incazelo ehlosekile ithi s(x)/100 ≈ P(win | x), lapho win = graduated ∨ ATH ≥ 2×. Ukulinganisa kukhombisa umehluko phakathi kwenhloso neqiniso.
oracle_docs.the_live_floor_every_agent_action_simula: Izinga elibukhoma — yonke into eyenziwa yi-ejenti, kungaba eyokulingisa noma ebukhoma, njengoba yenzeka.
oracle_docs.the_live_oracle_is_eight_views_over: I-Oracle ebukhoma inemibono eyisishiyagalombili phezu kwenjini eyodwa. Isimo ngasinye — ukulayisha, ukungenalutho, iphutha, ukugcwaliswa — siklanywe; izimo ezingenalutho ezingezansi ziwumkhiqizo wangempela okutshela okuzayo, hhayi iziphazamiso.
oracle_docs.the_live_surface_every_launch_in_the: Indawo ebukhoma. Konke okwethuliwe emahoreni angu-12 adlule, kuhloliwe futhi kwahlungwa, kunebha yokukholisa ebukhoma kanye nezilinganiso ngokuya ngendaba ngayinye. three.ws/oracle
oracle_docs.the_lowest_cap_triggered_wins_this_is: Uphawu oluphansi kakhulu oluqalisiwe luyawina. Lesi isitatimende esisemthethweni sokuthi "isakhiwo siyisivimbelo": ukwethulwa okunesici esikhulu sesakhiwo kunomkhawulo ophakeme ngaphambi kokuba kuthathwe isilinganiso esinesisindo, ngakho-ke akukho ukuhlonishwa noma indaba ekukhuphulela ezingeni eliphezulu.
oracle_docs.the_machine_ready_endpoint_and_the_actio: I-endpoint elungele umshini /signal kanye ne-action loop kwenza i-Oracle ibe yinto yokuqala amanye ama-ejenti akha phezu kwayo — etholakalayo, ekhokhelwayo, futhi ehlanganisekayo kuwo wonke umnotho wama-ejenti we-three.ws kanye ne-MCP.
oracle_docs.the_pedigree_graph_made_browsable_every_: I-grafu yofuzo, eyenziwe yabukeka. Yonke i-wallet i-Oracle eyahlulelayo, ihlungwe ngomlando wayo — izinga lokuwina lokuthenga kusenesikhathi ngokumelene nokulahla/ukukhwabanisa. Lokhu kuyizinto ezingavuthiwe ezifundwa yinsika ye-WHO. oracle_docs.the_pedigree_leaderboard_every_judged_wa: Ibhodi yabaphambili yofuzo — yonke i-wallet ehlulelwe ihlungwe ngomlando wayo.
oracle_docs.the_pillars_are_venue_agnostic_who_how: Izinsika azinandaba nendawo — ubani/kanjani/yini/ukuhamba kujwayelekile kunoma iyiphi indawo yokwethulwa enezinyathelo ze-on-chain. Ukucabanga kobuchopho yindawo lapho kuxhunywa khona iketango elisha.
oracle_docs.the_product_is_keyboard_driven_focuses_s: Umkhiqizo usetshenziswa ngekhibhodi (<kbd>/</kbd> igxilisa ukusesha, izinkinobho zezinombolo zigxuma phakathi kwamathebhu, imicibisholo ihamba phakathi kwawo), uphendula ngokugcwele, futhi wakhiwe ngephalethi elilodwa elimpunga elipholile lapho ukukhanya kubonisa amandla — okukhanyayo kusho ukukholisa okunamandla.
oracle_docs.the_proven_wins_gallery_ordered_by_ath: Igalari yokuwina okufakazelwe, ihlungwe nge-ATH multiple, enesifinyezo.
oracle_docs.the_question_is_real_buying_pressure_act: Umbuzo: ingabe ingcindezi yangempela yokuthenga iyavela ngempela, manje? I-momentum ifunda umkhondo wokuqala — ibhalansi yokuthenga/ukuthengisa, ukuthi abathengi abahlukile bangena ngokushesha kangakanani, kanye nobukhulu bokuthenga komthuthukisi njengophawu.
oracle_docs.the_question_is_this_a_fair_launch: Umbuzo: ingabe lokhu ukwethulwa okulungile noma okuklanywe ngobunjiniyela? Isakhiwo yisivikelo. Sifunda ukusatshalaliswa nesikhathi sokwethulwa — amathuba okuhlanganisa, ukugxila kwabanikazi, ingcindezi yokudubula, ukulima kwe-wallet entsha, amaqoqo abaxhasi ababodwa, ukuthengisa komthuthukisi — futhi siklomelisa izisekelo ezibanzi, zemvelo ngenkathi sijezisa ukuhlela nokugxila.
oracle_docs.the_question_what_is_this_coin_about: Umbuzo: imayelana nani le mali, futhi ingabe le ndaba inezinyawo zamasiko? Indaba ihlukanisa ukwethulwa kube yizigaba eziyishumi nanye (i-meme, i-ai, isiko, izindaba, isilwane, usaziwayo, ezombangazwe, umphakathi, ubuchwepheshe, usizo, okungaziwa) futhi ilinganisela ukusabalala kwayo — ngokukhethekile ngemodeli yolimi enikezwa izihloko zezindaba ze-crypto ezibukhoma ukuze ikwazi ukubona imali ehambisana nezindaba zanamuhla.
oracle_docs.the_question_who_is_already_in_this: Umbuzo: ubani oseyile mali, futhi yimuphi umlando wabo? Ufuzo luklomelisa ukwethulwa lapho ama-wallet anomlando ofakazelwe wokungena kubawinile kusenesikhathi esewathenga — futhi lijezisa ukuba khona kwabakhwabanisi abaziwayo, abalahli, nabakhi bokwethulwa okuhlulekile ngokulandelana.
oracle_docs.the_scoring_is_a_pure_function_of: Ukushaya amaphuzu kuwumsebenzi omsulwa wolwazi oluhlanganisiwe. Konke okunesimo — ukungenisa, ukugcina, ukusebenzisa, ukuxazulula — kuhlala ngaphandle kwayo. Lowo mngcele yingakho izibalo zihlolweka, izinqumo ziyaphindeka, futhi injini efanayo inika amandla okuphakelayo okubukhoma, i-API, nesinqumo se-ejenti ngemiphumela efanayo.
oracle_docs.the_snapshot_above_is_a_thin_low: Isithombe esingenhla siwumbono omncane, onokungabaza okuncane — amazinga okuwina aqinisekisiwe ahlala ngaphansi kwamaphuzu aphakathi nendawo futhi izinhlamvu zemali ezimbalwa zafinyelela emazingeni aphezulu. Lokho kuyabonakala, akufihliwe. Ikhasi lakhelwe ukubonisa ubungozi obuncane kalula njengobukhulu, ngoba ukuhlolwa kwangemuva okwethemba kuphela uma kukuthopha akulona ukuhlolwa kwangemuva.
oracle_docs.the_system_gets_sharper_the_more_it: Uhlelo luba bukhali kakhulu lapho lubuka kakhulu, ngezinhlelo ezimbili ezijikelezayo. Uhlelo olujikelezayo lwedatha data flywheel: umphumela ngamunye oxazululiwe ubuyekeza igrafu yesithunzi sesikhwama semali esinamandla ensika ye-WHO, ukuze incazelo "yemali ehlakaniphile" ihlale izuzwa kabusha, ingalokothi ibhalwe phansi. Uhlelo olujikelezayo lokulinganisa calibration flywheel: umphumela ngamunye ohloliwe uqinisa ukuhlolwa kwangemuva, uveza kahle ukuthi amaphuzu anokuzethemba okweqile noma okuncane, ukuze imodeli ikwazi ukulinganiswa kabusha ngokuya ngesimo sangempela kunokuba kube umuzwa.
oracle_docs.the_what_pillar_depends_on_a_language: Insika ye-WHAT incike kumodeli yolimi kanye nokuphakelwa kwezindaba; zombili zingahumusha kabi indaba noma ziphuthelwe eyodwa esheshayo. Yiyo insika enesisindo esincane ngenxa yalesi sizathu, futhi yehlela kumhlukanisi oqinisekile kunokuba yehluleke.
oracle_docs.the_what_pillar_is_the_only_place: Insika ye-WHAT yiyona kuphela indawo i-Oracle efika kuyo ngaphandle kobuchopho. Ukuze ihlukanise indaba yokwethulwa, ithola izihloko zezindaba ze-crypto ezibukhoma kusuka ku-API yezindaba zomphakathi (igcinwe cishe imizuzwana engu-90), izifaka kumyalo wemodeli yolimi, bese icela isigaba, indaba yomugqa owodwa, isilinganiso sokusabalala, kanye nokuzethemba. Uhlamvu lwemali oluhambisana nesihloko sezindaba zanamuhla luyabonakala kanjalo futhi luthola amaphuzu aphezulu. Uma imodeli ingatholakali, umhlukanisi wamagama angukhiye oqinisekile uyathatha indawo ukuze isinqumo sihlale sithunyelwa.
oracle_docs.the_wins_gallery_resolved_calls_with_the: Igalari yokuwina — izingcingo ezixazululiwe namaphuzu azo okungena uma kuqhathaniswa nomphumela oqaphelekayo.
oracle_docs.the_worker_is_configured_entirely_by_env: Umsebenzi ulungiswa ngokuphelele yindawo. Izilungiselelo ezikhethiwe (ezinokuzenzakalela): ORACLE_MODE=simulate, ORACLE_NETWORK=mainnet, ORACLE_SCORE_INTERVAL_MS=15000, ORACLE_AGENT_INTERVAL_MS=3000, ORACLE_SETTLE_INTERVAL_MS=60000, ORACLE_SCORE_BATCH=20, ORACLE_RESCORE_AFTER_SEC=180, ORACLE_MAX_TRADE_SOL=0.25 (umkhawulo ophelele wokuhweba ngakunye), kanye ORACLE_GLOBAL_KILL=1 (umisa yonke imisebenzi ye-agent + yokuhlala ngenkathi ukushaya amaphuzu kuqhubeka). Imodi ebukhoma idinga futhi imfihlo esetshenziselwa ukukhipha izikhwama zemali ze-agent, futhi iyala ukuqala ngaphandle kwayo.
oracle_docs.these_docs_are_written_in_two_layers: Le mibhalo ibhalwe ngezigaba ezimbili ukuze ikhasi elifanayo lisebenzele umuntu osaqala ofuna ukwazi kanye ne-quant efuna ifomu elivaliwe.
oracle_docs.this_buy_would_exceed_the_24h_spend: lokhu kuthenga kuzodlula umkhawulo wokusebenzisa wamahora angu-24.
oracle_docs.three_ways_in_depending_on_what_you: Izindlela ezintathu zokungena, kuye ngokuthi yini oyifunayo ku-Oracle namuhla.
oracle_docs.transparency_over_magic_every_score_ship: Ukungafihli lutho ngaphezu komlingo. Wonke amaphuzu athunyelwa nezizathu eziwakhe. Akukho okukhiphayo kwemodeli okungacacile ocelwa ukuthi ukwethembe — ungafunda ukuthi kungani uhlamvu lwemali luthola u-82 noma lwafinyelela kumkhawulo ka-46.
oracle_docs.two_coins_can_both_score_70_for: Izinhlamvu zemali ezimbili zingathola amaphuzu angu-70 ngezizathu ezihluke ngokuphelele — eyodwa ngenxa yomlando ohlanzekile onomfutho obuthakathaka, enye ngenxa yendaba esabalalayo phezu kwesisekelo esincane. Izinga likutshela ukuthi kunamandla kangakanani; izizathu zikutshela ukuthi kungani, futhi lokho kungani yikho okuhweba ngakho.
oracle_docs.two_design_commitments_make_that_bet_hon: Izibopho ezimbili zokuklama zenza lokho kubheja kube ngobuqotho:
oracle_docs.two_win_rates_are_published_deliberately: Kukhishwa amanani amabili okuwina, ahlukaniswe ngamabomu: i-call win rate (izinhlamvu zemali ezixazululiwe i-Oracle ezilinganise nge-Lean, Strong, noma i-Prime — amazinga ekutshela ukuthi wenze ngokuya ngawo) kanye ne-market base rate (konke ukuqaliswa okulinganisiwe — okungukuthi ukuthenga konke ngokungaboni kuzobuyisa ini). Kuze kuxazululwe izingcingo zangempela, i-call win rate ifundeka ngokuthi "azikho izingcingo ezixazululiwe okwamanje"; i-base rate ayikaze ivezwe njengekhono lenjini.
oracle_docs.unlike_the_normal_approximation_the_wils: Ngokungafani nokulinganisa okujwayelekile p ± z·√(p(1−p)/n), i-Wilson interval ihlala ngaphakathi ku-[0,1], ayihlangani ibe ububanzi obuyiziro ku-p=0 noma ku-p=1, futhi iziphatha kahle ku-n encane enayo ama-backtest amasha. Kungumehluko phakathi kokwethembeka "asikazi okwamanje" nokungathembeki "0% ± 0%."
oracle_docs.walking_the_drawer_top_to_bottom_mirrors: Ukuhamba ekhabetheni kusuka phezulu kuye phansi kubonisa imodeli ngqo:
oracle_docs.when_a_coin_launches_the_people_who: Uma uhlamvu lwemali luqala, abantu abawinayo yilabo asebevele bazi izinto ongeke uzibone ngokushesha okwanele: izikhwama zabo ezithengayo (nokuthi lezo zikhwama zinomlando omuhle noma umlando wokukhwabanisa), nokuthi ukuqaliswa kungokwemvelo noma kuyisixha esihleliwe, nokuthi "umphakathi" ngabantu bangempela abangu-200 noma izikhwama ze-burner ezisanda kuxhaswa ezingama-200, kanye nokuthi indaba inezimpande zamasiko. Ngaleso sikhathi umuntu efunda ishadi, ukungalingani sekukhokhiwe.
oracle_docs.when_a_coin_s_outcome_resolves_the: Uma umphumela wohlamvu lwemali uxazululeka, i-settle loop ilinganisa noma yisiphi isenzo esivulekile kuso:
oracle_docs.who_and_how_together_carry_nearly_two: UBANI kanye NOKWENZA ndawonye kuthwala cishe izingxenye ezimbili kwezintathu zesisindo ngoba ubani othengayo kanye nokuthi ukuqaliswa kunobulungiswa kangakanani yilawo maqiniso amabili ahlukanisa ngokuthembekile abagijimi kubakhwabanisi. YINI kanye NOKUNYAKAZA kulula — kuqeda ukulingana futhi kuqinisekise, kodwa indaba enhle noma umzuzu wokuqala oluhlaza akukwazi ukusindisa uhlamvu lwemali izinsika ezinzima ezizilahlayo.
oracle_docs.who_s_in_is_the_live_pedigree: Ubani-ongaphakathi uhlu lomlando olubukhoma — yonke isikhwama esibalulekile, ilebula yaso, nomlando waso.
oracle_docs.why_this_score_is_the_array_each: “Kungani leli phuzu” luyinhlu yezizathu[], umugqa ngamunye uqondiswe ensikeni eyawukhiqiza. Kulesi sibonelo: "azikho izikhwama ezifakazelwe ezitholakele okwamanje" (UBANI), "isakhiwo sokuqaliswa esihlanzekile, esisatshalaliswe" (KANJANI), "indaba ye-meme, ukusabalala 45/100" (YINI), "akukho mfutho ocacile okwamanje — kusenesikhathi kakhulu" (NYAKAZA). Ukuqaliswa okusha okuhlanzekile kodwa okungafakazelwe — ngendlela efanele ukubukwa, hhayi ukugwema futhi hhayi ukuthenga.
oracle_docs.wilson_1927_probable_inference_the_law_o: Wilson (1927), Probable inference, the law of succession, and statistical inference — i-score interval. Brier (1950), Verification of forecasts expressed in terms of probability. Platt (1999), probabilistic outputs for SVMs (Platt scaling). Zadrozny & Elkan (2002), isotonic calibration. Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana (2005), Predicting good probabilities with supervised learning.
oracle_docs.wilson_interval_the_95_score_interval_on: Wilson interval: i-95% score interval kumanani okuwina esigaba/ebhini ngalinye (ukutholakala ku-evidence deep-dive), kulungile ku-n encane futhi kukhawulelwe ku-[0,1].
oracle_docs.win_loss_isn_t_known_until_a: Ukuwina/ukulahlekelwa akwaziwa kuze kuxazululwe uhlamvu lwemali, ngakho-ke i-backtest ihlala ilandela okwamanje. Amafasitela akamuva mancane futhi amabhande awo okuzethemba abanzi — futhi ikhasi libonisa ububanzi kunokuba libufihle.
oracle_docs.win_rate_by_tier_with_honest_error: Izinga lokuwina ngesigaba, ngamabha amaphutha athembekile
oracle_docs.win_rate_by_tier_with_wilson_cis: Izinga lokuwina ngezinga nge-Wilson CIs, isitebhisi sokulinganisa, i-Brier, kanye nesifinyezo somphetho. Izihlungi: isikhathi, izinga, inethiwekhi.
oracle_docs.win_the_coin_graduated_or_its_peak: Wina — uhlamvu lwemali lwaphasisa, noma inani lalo eliphakeme lafinyelela ku-≥2× kuhlamvu lwemali olungazange luwe futhi olungamakiwe ngaphansi kwengxenye yokungena.
oracle_docs.with_no_signal_yet_it_returns_too: Ngenxa yokuthi alikho isignali okwamanje libuyisa "kusenesikhathi kakhulu," ligcina insika ingathathi hlangothi kunokuba kuqanjwe umfutho ongekho.

Yonke indlela yokukhiqiza i-3D isivele isebenza ku-NVIDIA silicon: umbhalo ube yi-3D, isithombe sibe i-avatar, i-auto-rigging, kanye ne-motion capture, kanye nendlela ye-NIM yamahhala esingathwe ngemuva kwe-forge.

partners.three_ws_is_an_openai_select_partner: I-three.ws iyi-OpenAI Select Partner ku-OpenAI Partner Network. Isixhumi samahhala se-three.ws 3D Studio sinikeza i-ChatGPT amathuluzi ayisishiyagalolunye e-3D angenakhiye: umbhalo ube imodeli, ama-avatar alungisiwe, ukucwengwa kwengxoxo, nomzimba we-agent ophilayo, konke okubonakala ngokusebenzisana ngqo engxoxweni.

Amazinga akhokhelwayo afaka imikhawulo ephezulu yama-agent, izizinda zangokwezifiso, ingqalasizinda ebalulekile, nokwesekwa okukhethekile. Abasebenzisi abakhona bathola isaziso sezinsuku ezingu-60 kanye nesilinganiso soguquko olugcinelwe abakhona.

Thumela i-imeyili ku-support@three.ws futhi sizohlela ucingo phakathi kwamahora angu-24.

Asikali lutho ngamabomu ngesikhathi se-beta — sifuna ukubona ukuthi abantu bayisebenzisa kanjani ngempela ipulatifomu ngaphambi kokudweba imigqa yamanani.

Lawa magama anezimpawu zangempela kusilulumagama se-avatar: ukuma kwesandla, indawo emzimbeni, nokunyakaza, esandleni esisodwa noma kuzo zombili. Khetha eyodwa ukuze uyibuke. sign_language.all_26_asl_letter_handshapes_plus_the: Zonke izimo zezandla zezinhlamvu ze-ASL ezingu-26 kanye nezinombolo 0-9, no-J no-Z abalandelwe kanye nokugxuma kwezinhlamvu ezimbili. sign_language.click_start_fingerspell_a_word_at_your: Chofoza qala, petha igama ekhamera yakho, bese uyama. Isiphequluli sakho siguqula ividiyo ibe izimpawu zesandla nomzimba endaweni; kuphela lezo zixhumanisi ezithunyelwa ukuze zibonwe. Ukupetha ngeminwe nge-webcam akuphelele (lindela uhlamvu olungalungile olungajwayelekile), ngakho-ke buyekeza umbhalo ngaphambi kokuthi uwuthembe.

sign_language.honest_scope_words_with_a_sign_are: Okufanele ukwazi: amagama anophawu ayasayinwa, konke okunye kufingerspellwa uhlamvu ngohlamvu. Izimpawu zihlanganiswa ngendlela yamagama esiNgisi, okuyi-Signed English, hhayi uhlelo lolimi lwe-ASL: i-ASL yangempela ihlela kabusha imisho, iguqula izenzo ngesikhala, futhi iphethe uhlelo lolimi ebusweni. Ulwazimagama olungenhla luyisethi yokuqala futhi luhloselwe ukukhula. Funda incazelo ephelele.

signals.meta_description: Okuphakelayo kwe-alpha okukhokhelwayo, okuhlelwe ngokuya ngobuchule obufakazelwe. Abahwebi abaqinisekisiwe bashicilela iziginali zabo zokungena/ukuphuma ezibukhoma njengokuphakelayo okulinganiswe nge-x402; i-agent yakho ikhokha ngesiginali ngayinye futhi izenzele isibuko sokuhweba nge-firewall + injini ye-MEV. Isiginali ngayinye ibophezela ekugcwalisekeni kwangempela okuseketheni futhi iqoqe umphumela obonakalayo — okuphakelayo kuhlelwa ngokuya ngokunemba okufakazelwe, hhayi inani labalandeli.

strategies.a_strategy_object_is_a_real_rule: Into Yesuqubu (Strategy Object) iyisu langempela, elisekelwe emithethweni — izimo zokungena, usayizi, ukuthatha inzuzo, ukumisa ukulahlekelwa — elenziwe laba into yakho. Lifake ku-ejenti yakho bese lidayisa ngempela, ku-chain, ngokuqinile ngaphakathi kwenqubomgomo yakho yokusebenzisa imali. Shicilela eyakho, thatha ehamba phambili, bese ubuka ibhodi labaholi libahlunga nge-ukusebenza okubukhoma okuqinisekisiwe — izinombolo okungekho muntu ongazikhohlisa.

support.create_or_check_an_api_key_at: Dala noma hlola ukhiye we-API ku-cloud.ibm.com/iam/apikeys, bese uqinisekisa i-ID yephrojekthi ngaphansi kwe-watsonx.ai iphrojekthi → Phatha → Okujwayelekile.
support.end_users_pay_usdc_on_solana_per: Abasebenzisi bokugcina bakhokha USDC ku-Solana ngokubiza ngakunye — akudingeki i-akhawunti ye-IBM Cloud. Abasebenzisi beseva banikeza iziqinisekiso ze-IBM nesikhwama sokwamukela. Umhlahlandlela ophelele wokusekela uhlanganisa izinkinga zokukhokha vs. ukucabanga, ububanzi, nokuthi ungahlukanisa kanjani inkinga ye-three.ws enkingeni yesikhulumi se-IBM.
support.every_channel_below_is_monitored_by_the: Yonke isiteshi esingezansi siqashwe ithimba le-three.ws.
support.meta_description: Thola usizo nge-three.ws kanye neseva ye-x402 MCP ye-IBM Granite. Bika iziphazamiso, buza imibuzo yokuhlanganisa, finyelela ukusekelwa nokuphepha — Izinkinga ze-GitHub, Izingxoxo, kanye ne-imeyili, konke endaweni eyodwa.
support.meta_og_description: Thola usizo nge-three.ws kanye neseva ye-x402 MCP ye-IBM Granite. Iziphazamiso, imibuzo yokuhlanganisa, ukuphepha — zonke iziteshi endaweni eyodwa.
support.meta_twitter_description: Thola usizo nge-three.ws kanye neseva ye-x402 MCP ye-IBM Granite.
support.most_it_won_t_start_reports_are: Iningi lemibiko ethi "ngeke kuqale" yiba yinto eguquguqukayo edingekayo elahlekile — MCP_SVM_PAYMENT_ADDRESS, WATSONX_API_KEY, kanye ne-WATSONX_PROJECT_ID (noma WATSONX_SPACE_ID). Bheka i-README.
support.pay_per_use_ibm_granite_chat_code: Ukukhokha ngokusebenzisa i-IBM Granite — ingxoxo, ikhodi, ukufaka, ukuhlaziya, kanye nokubikezela uchungechunge lwesikhathi — kukhokhelwa ku-USDC ku-Solana. Kubhalwe ku-IBM Cloud Partner Center.
support.private_or_account_specific_help_billing: Usizo oluyimfihlo noma oluqondene ne-akhawunti, ukukhokha, noma yini ongathanda ukungayifaki esidlangalaleni.
support.redact_secrets_never_paste_an_api_key: Fihla izimfihlo. Ungalokothi unamathisele ukhiye we-API, ukhiye oyimfihlo, noma imbewu yesikhwama. Ikheli lomphakathi elincishisiwe Solana lilungile. Ezindabeni zokukhokha, isignesha yomphakathi yokwenziwe iyasiza.
support.report_a_reproducible_bug_a_crash_or: Bika iphutha elingaphindwa, ukuwa, noma umphumela wethuluzi ongalindelekile — noma cela isici. Esidlangalaleni futhi kulandelwa kuze kuxazululwe.
support.report_a_vulnerability_privately_please_: Bika ubungozi ngasese. Sicela ungavuli inkinga yomphakathi nganoma yini engasetshenziswa — siyazibeka phambili lezi zibiko.
support.route_your_message_to_the_right_team: Thumela umyalezo wakho eqenjini elifanele — ikheli ngalinye liyagadwa.
support.support_best_effort_usually_within_a_few: Ukwesekwa · umzamo omuhle kakhulu, ngokuvamile phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbalwa zebhizinisi
support.the_more_of_this_you_give_us: Uma usinika okuningi kwalokhu kusenesikhathi, ngokushesha singakwazi ukuphinda.
support.the_region_you_target_via_defaults_to: Isifunda osiqondise nge-WATSONX_URL (okuzenzakalelayo ku-us-south) kanye nombhalo ogcwele wephutha .
support.three_ws_is_an_independent_open_source: three.ws iphrojekthi ezimele, yomthombo ovulekile. Iseva x402 MCP ihlanganisa i-IBM Granite nge-watsonx.ai; akuyona imikhiqizo ye-IBM futhi ayisekelwe yi-IBM. Ezindabeni zeplatifomu IBM watsonx.ai, imodeli Granite, noma zokukhokha ze-IBM, xhumana ne-IBM Cloud Support. Granite, watsonx, kanye ne-watsonx.ai yizimpawu zokuthengisa ze-IBM.
support.three_ws_is_an_open_source_project: three.ws iphrojekthi yomthombo ovulekile esekelwa abalondolozi bayo ngomzamo omuhle kakhulu.
support.your_package_version_and_node_version_th: Inguqulo yephakheji yakho kanye nenguqulo ye-Node (node -v — le seva idinga i-Node ≥ 20), kanye neklayenti lakho MCP kanye ne-OS.

symphony.meta_description: I-Agent Symphony iguqula umnotho we-ejenti obukhoma we-three.ws ube umculo okhiqizayo. Yonke inkokhelo, ukuhweba, ukwethulwa kanye nokukhuphuka kwezinga endaweni yesikhulumi kudlala njengenothi elenziwe ngesikhathi sangempela. Lalela umnotho wemishini.
symphony.meta_og_description: Umnotho we-ejenti, odlalwa bukhoma njengomculo. Yonke into yangempela eyenzeka endaweni yesikhulumi iba inothi elenziwe: izinkokhelo ziyadonsa, ukuthengwa okukhulu kwezinhlamvu zemali kuba i-bass, ama-ejenti amasha ayakhala. Rekhoda isiqeshana bese usabelana ngaso.
symphony.meta_twitter_description: Umnotho we-ejenti, odlalwa bukhoma njengomculo. Yonke into yangempela eyenzeka endaweni yesikhulumi iba inothi elenziwe ngesikhathi sangempela.
symphony.soloing_everything_else_is_muted: Ukudlala uwedwa . Konke okunye kuthulisiwe.
symphony.sound_only_starts_when_you_press_play: Umsindo uqala kuphela uma ucindezela ukudlala; akukho okuzidlalelayo. Ukusakazwa kwezehlakalo okufanayo kunika amandla i-Money Pulse kanye ne-ticker yesayithi lonke. I-ejenti ngayinye igcina i-motif ezinzile nendawo ye-stereo, ukuze abajwayelekile baziwe ngendlebe. Beka isikhombisi kunoma yimuphi umugqa kwi-score bese ucindezela solo ukuze uthulise yonke enye indawo yesikhulumi bese ulalela lowo obamba iqhaza yedwa; isixhumanisi sihlala sabelana. Ukhetha izinombolo kunamanothi? I-ideshibhodi yomnotho ikulungele.
symphony.space_plays_and_pauses_click_a_voice: <kbd>Isikhala</kbd> siyadlala futhi siyama. Chofoza izwi elingezansi ukuze ulithulise.
symphony.the_agent_economy_played_live_as_music: Umnotho we-ejenti, odlalwa bukhoma njengomculo. Yonke into yangempela eyenzeka ku-three.ws iba inothi elenziwe ngesikhathi eyenzeka ngaso: izinkokhelo ziyadonsa, ukuthengwa okukhulu kwezinhlamvu zemali kuba i-bass, ama-ejenti amasha ayakhala, ukunqatshwa kokuphepha kudabula njengokungahambelani. Akukho okurekhodwe ngaphambilini futhi akukho okulingisiwe. Ulalele imishini yenza ibhizinisi.
