three_ws_launch_week.1_010_members_in_the_x_community:
1,010 amalungu emphakathini we-X.
Kusukela ku-zero. Ngeviki elilodwa.
three_ws_launch_week.beyond_the_analytics_dashboard_three_ws_: Ngaphezu kwedeshibhodi yezibalo, three.ws yafika ezinkombini, amarejista, namapulatifomu abaluleke kakhulu kuthuluzi lonjiniyela lomthombo ovulekile.
three_ws_launch_week.elevenlabs_voice_cloning_from_3_10_secon: Ukukopisha izwi kwe-ElevenLabs kusukela kumasekhondi angu-3–10 enkulumo, ukukhipha ubuntu engxoxweni emfushane yokuqala, nokufaka imemori ngokuvunyelwe kusuka kuma-akhawunti axhunyiwe — i-avatar ayisona nje wena, i-agent enza njengawe.
three_ws_launch_week.listed_on_the_official_model_context_pro: Kubhalwe ku-Irejista esemthethweni ye-Model Context Protocol.
three_ws_launch_week.meta_og_description: Ipulatifomu ye-agent ye-AI ye-3D yomthombo ovulekile yesiphequluli. Iviki lokuqala ngezibalo nokuthi yini esiyilethile.
three_ws_launch_week.meta_twitter_description: Konke three.ws okulethwe ngesikhathi seviki lokwethulwa — ama-avatar e-3D, izinkokhelo ze-agent, ibazaar ye-x402, nokunye okuningi.
three_ws_launch_week.open_source_3d_ai_agent_platform_apache: Ipulatifomu ye-agent ye-AI ye-3D yomthombo ovulekile. Apache 2.0. Yakhiwe nge-three.js, i-Claude, nangokukholwa ukuthi i-AI ifanele umzimba.
three_ws_launch_week.pulled_directly_from_x_analytics_for_try: Kuthathwe ngqo kusuka ku-X analytics kwa @trythreews phakathi kuka-Ephreli 29 noMeyi 9. Akukho ukuhlunga, akukho maqhinga okulinganisa — izinombolo eziyinhloko ezingezansi namashadi angezansi avela kusithombe-skrini esifanayo.
three_ws_launch_week.reputation_markets_staking_on_agents_sig: Izimakethe zedumela ezifaka imali emlandweni wezenzo osayiniwe wama-agent, imali yobukhosi yamakhono ye-EIP-7710 ekhokhelwa ababhali bamakhono ngocingo ngalunye, nezinkokhelo ezizimele phakathi kwama-agent ngama-wallet asayina ngokudlulisa igunya.
three_ws_launch_week.the_custom_element_loads_lazily_on_inter: I-elementi yangokwezifiso <agent-3d> ilayisha kancane lapho ihlangana, isekela izinhlobo ezinhlanu zama-widget (i-turntable, igalari yopopayi, i-agent ekhulumayo, ERC-8004 ikhadi lephasipoti, uhambo lwe-hotspot), futhi ikhipha i-Open Graph kanye ne-oEmbed metadata ukuze izixhumanisi zivele ngokuqukethwe okubanzi. I-Widget Studio yokuchofoza-nokukhomba ikhiqiza ikhodi yokufaka yokukopisha-nokunamathisela ku /studio. Ama-bundle e-CDN anezinguqulo athunyelwa ku /agent-3d/x.y.z/.
three_ws_launch_week.the_google_cloud_announcement_was_the_si: Isimemezelo se-Google Cloud sasiwukuphela kokuthunyelwe okuthola ukuzibandakanya okuphezulu kakhulu kuleli sonto (~6.9K ukubukwa, 263 ukuthandwa, 24 ukuthunyelwa kabusha) kanye nengqalasizinda yamafu esekela isigaba esilandelayo seplatifomu.
three_ws_launch_week.the_inside_the_3d_agent_web_podcast: Isiqephu se-podcast esithi “Inside The 3D Agent Web” sishicilelwe ku-Amazon Music futhi ibhulogi ehambisanayo ethi “Beyond Chatbots: Why Your AI Agent Needs a 3D Body” yakhishwa nge-ecosystem ye-Spotify-on-chain. Izindawo ezimbili ezengeziwe zokusabalalisa, isonto elilodwa elengeziwe.
three_ws_launch_week.the_platform_shipped_as_a_partner_listin: Iplatifomu ikhishwe njengohlu lwabalingani ku-Alibaba Cloud, isiteshi sethu sokuqala sokusabalalisa emakethe yamafu. I-tweet yokwethulwa ehambisanayo yathola ~7.1K ukubukwa yodwa.
three_ws_launch_week.the_roadmap_closes_the_gap_from_use: Imephu yomgwaqo ivala igebe ukusuka “ekusebenziseni umculi we-3D” kuya “ekuthatheni i-selfie”. Izigaba ezine, ezihloliwe kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni ku-README yomphakathi.
three_ws_launch_week.the_runtime_drives_a_claude_tool_loop: I-runtime iqhuba i-Claude tool-loop enokuphindaphinda okungafika kokuyisishiyagalombili ngokuphambana ngakunye namathuluzi ayisithupha akhelwe ngaphakathi (wave, lookAt, play_clip, setExpression, speak, remember). I-Empathy Layer akuyona umshini wesimo — iyi ’ngxube eqhubekayo enesisindo yemizwa emihlanu (ukugubha, ukukhathazeka, ilukuluku, uzwelo, ukubekezela), ngamunye unempilo yawo yokubola, eqhuba ama-morph targets e-avatar ’ kanye nesimo sekhanda kuwo wonke amafreyimu. Amakhono angama-bundle azimele asatshalaliswa nge-IPFS, i-Arweave, noma i-HTTP. Imemori isekelwe kumafayela ngezindlela ezine zokugcina (yasendaweni, i-IPFS, i-encrypted-IPFS, akukho).
three_ws_launch_week.the_three_ws_x_community_is_the: Umphakathi we-X three.ws yizithameli ezibuthene — abathuthukisi, abakhi abafuna ukwazi ngama-agent, kanye neqembu labantu abalandelayo bukhoma. Yilapho kuzovela khona igagasi elilandelayo labanikazi bama-agent ’.
three_ws_launch_week.three_selfies_left_center_right_gpu_back: Ama-selfie amathathu (kwesokunxele, phakathi, kwesokudla), ukwakhiwa kabusha kobuso okubukwa ngezindlela eziningi okusekelwa yi-GPU, kanye ne-avatar elungisiwe, elingaphiliswa elakhiwe njenge-token engumqulu ERC-8004 ngaphansi kwamasekhondi angamashumi ayisithupha. I-UX yokuthwebula eqala ngeselula enamasango ekhwalithi yesikhathi sangempela.
three_ws_launch_week.three_solidity_contracts_make_up_the_erc: Izinkontileka ezintathu ze-Solidity zakha ukusetshenziswa kwe-ERC-8004: IdentityRegistry (ama-token e-agent e-ERC-721 anabasayini be-EIP-712 abamele), ReputationRegistry (impendulo ebhaliwe yabahloli, ebalwe ngokwesilinganiso ku-chain), kanye ne-ValidationRegistry (izitifiketi zabaqinisekisi zobufakazi obungekho ku-chain). Wonke umcimbi we-speak, remember, kanye ne-skill-done usayinwa futhi ulogwe. Solana iletha okufanayo isebenzisa ama-NFT e-Metaplex Core kanye nezitifiketi ze-SPL Memo ezisayiniwe — ukuma okufanayo, akukho hlelo olukhethekile oludingekayo.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_an_open_source_browser: three.ws iyipulatifomu ye-3D AI agent evulekile, esebenza kusiphequluli. Silethe i-stack ephelele — isibukeli, i-agent runtime, ubunikazi obuku-chain, i-server ye-OAuth 2.1, i-endpoint ye-MCP, kanye ne-web component engashumekwa — sabe sesibuka ukwethulwa kuphumelela. Nakhu okwenzekile.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_organized_as_four_communicat: three.ws ihlelwe njengezingqimba ezine ezixhumanayo, kanye ne-backend kanye ne-package yezinkontileka. Yonke ingqimba isetshenziswa ku-three.ws futhi ilethwa njengengxenye ye-repo evulekile. Nalu uhlu.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_published_as_on_registry: three.ws ishicilelwe njenge-io.github.nirholas/three.ws ku-registry.modelcontextprotocol.io futhi ingatholakala nge-directory ekhethiwe ye-PulseMCP’. Noma yimuphi iklayenti elinolwazi lwe-MCP (kuhlanganise ne-Claude Desktop) lingaxhuma futhi lisebenzise ama-avatar nge-JSON-RPC.
three_ws_launch_week.vercel_functions_on_neon_postgres_cloudf: Imisebenzi ye-Vercel ku-Neon Postgres, Cloudflare R2, naku-Upstash Redis. I-server ephelele ye-OAuth 2.1 (RFC 6749 + PKCE, ukubhaliswa okuguquguqukayo kwe-RFC 7591, ukubuyiswa kwe-RFC 7009, ukuhlola kwe-RFC 7662, ukutholwa kwe-RFC 8414, ukutholwa kwezinsiza ezivikelwe ze-RFC 9728). I-server ye-MCP nge-HTTP — imigqa engu-759, i-JSON-RPC 2.0, efakwe ohlwini ku-Model Context Protocol Registry esemthethweni njenge-io.github.nirholas/three.ws. Imisebenzi ye-Cron ye-ERC-8004 crawler, i-EIP-7710 delegation indexer, ukwenziwa kwesu le-DCA, kanye nokubhaliselwa okuphindaphindwayo ku-chain.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_2_0_rendering_with_full_gltf: Ukunikezwa kwe-WebGL 2.0 ngokusekelwa okugcwele kwe-glTF 2.0 / GLB: Ukucindezela kwe-Draco geometry, ukucindezela kwe-KTX2 texture, ukulungiswa kwe-Meshopt mesh, amamephu emvelo e-HDR, izinto ze-PBR, i-animation enesikhumba, ama-morph target, namakhamera ashumekwe. Ukuqinisekiswa kusezingeni lomugqa nge-Khronos gltf-validator. Ukulayisha ngokudonsa nokulahla, i-OrbitControls enokuzungeza okuzenzakalelayo okungalungiseka, kanye ne-dat.GUI yesikhathi sangempela yokulungisa ngokushesha.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_viewer_llm_agent_runtime_erc_8004: Isibukeli se-WebGL, i-LLM agent runtime, izinkontileka zobunikazi ze-ERC-8004, i-server ye-OAuth 2.1, i-endpoint ye-MCP, kanye ne-web component ye-<agent-3d> — konke okufundile ngenhla. Bukhoma ku-three.ws namuhla.

threews_claim.get_as_a_solana_name_service_subdomain: Thola yourname.threews.sol njenge-subdomain ye-Solana Name Service. I-Brave Browser iyixazulula ngqo ku-three.ws showcase yakho. Ama-agent akho, ama-avatar, namakhono, konke ngaphansi kwegama elilodwa.

trading.hero_sub: Imikhumbi yama-ejenti e-AI ihweba ngezinhlamvu zemali ezisanda kwethulwa ezivela kuma-wallet awo e-Solana, ngaphansi kwemithetho abangakwazi ukuyiphika. Konke okungenayo kuyashaywa amaphuzu, yonke indawo ilinganiswa nesabelomali esiqinile sobungozi, futhi konke okugcwalisiwe kusayinwe yisihluthulelo se-ejenti futhi kuqinisekiswe ku-chain. Leli khasi yigumbi lokulawula: ukuthi imikhumbi yenzani manje, ukuthi inquma kanjani, nokuthi izoya kuphi ngokulandelayo.
trading.meta_description: Igumbi lokulawula lokuhweba okuzimele kwe-three.ws: izinto ezibalulekile zemikhumbi bukhoma, ibhodi lamaphuzu e-ejenti, ipayipi eligcwele lokungena nokuphuma, nazo zonke izindawo zokuhweba endaweni eyodwa. Ama-wallet angempela, ukugcwaliswa kwangempela, okuqinisekiswe ku-chain.
trading.meta_og_description: Ulwazi olubukhoma lwemikhumbi, ibhodi lezikolo lama-ejenti, nazo zonke izindawo zokuhweba ezizimele endaweni eyodwa.
trading.meta_twitter_description: Ulwazi olubukhoma lwemikhumbi, ibhodi lezikolo lama-ejenti, nazo zonke izindawo zokuhweba ezizimele endaweni eyodwa.
trading.pipeline_sub: Konke okungenayo kudlula emasangweni afanayo, ngalolu hlelo. Isango elingakwazi ukufakazela ukuthi uhlamvu lwemali luphephile livimba ukuhweba kunokuba liqagele.
trading.rail_budget_body: Usayizi wokuhweba ngakunye, ukusetshenziswa kwansuku zonke, kanye nenani eliphezulu lezikhundla ezifanayo yimikhawulo ehlolwa ngaphambi kokusakazwa ngakunye.
trading.rail_custody_body: Ama-ejenti ahweba ngamakhi awo siqu ngendlela yokugcinwa ehloliwe. Funda imodeli yokugcinwa.
trading.rail_kill_body: Emhlabeni wonke nangokwe-ejenti ngayinye. Ukuyicisha kumisa okungenayo okusha ngokushesha, futhi umnikazi angakwazi njalo ukukhipha isikhwama.
trading.rail_moonbag_body: Inqubomgomo yemikhumbi igcina isabelo esincane sesikhundla esiwinekayo ngokwakhiwa, ngakho-ke isinqumo esihle asikwazi ukudayiswa ngokuphelele kusenesikhathi.
trading.rail_risk_body: Ukuhweba ngezinhlamvu zemali ezisanda kwethulwa kungalahlekisa isikhundla sonke. Funda ukuvuma ingozi ngaphambi kokuhlomisa noma yini.
trading.rail_stop_body: Yonke isu elihlonyisiwe liphethe isicishi sokulahlekelwa, eliqiniswa umkhawulo wedatha. Isu elingenaso alikwazi ukuba khona.
trading.safety_rails_sub: Lezi ziqiniswa kukhodi nasendaweni yedatha, hhayi kumyalo. I-ejenti ayikwazi ukuzixoxela indlela yokudlula kunoma yiziphi zazo.
trading.scoreboard_sub: Inzuzo elungile nokulahlekelwa nge-ejenti ngayinye, ukuhweba okuvaliwe kuphela. Izikhundla ezivulekile azibalwa njengenzuzo.
trading.step_exit_body: Cishe kabili okungenayo i-ejenti idayisa okwanele ukubuyisa isabelo sayo bese igcina okusele njengesikhwama senyanga ngesicishi esilandelelayo. Isicishi sokulahlekelwa esiqinile siwina zonke izingxabano, futhi isicishi sesikhathi sivala noma yini engayi ndawo.
trading.step_firewall_body: Ukuthenga nokudayisa kwangempela kuyalingiswa ku-chain ngaphambi kokusakazwa. Uma ukudayisa kubuyela emuva, uhlamvu lwemali alukwazi ukuphuma futhi ukuhweba kuyavinjwa. Amandla okukhiqiza nokumisa ahlolwa ngesikhathi esifanayo.
trading.step_score_body: Uhlamvu lwemali luhlungwa ngesigaba semakethe, umlando womdali, izinkundla zokuxhumana kanye nempahla yokucaphuna. Amanye ama-ejenti asebenzisa imithetho egxilile, amanye anikeza isinqumo kumodeli yolimi, futhi ibhodi lezikolo elingenhla yilo elixazulula ingxabano.
trading.step_signal_body: Ukwethulwa, isicelo sokuqala semali, ukuwela kwe-oracle, noma ukuphothula kufika kokuphakelayo. Umsebenzi ugcina okuphakelayo kuvulekile, ngakho-ke kusabela ngesekhondi elifanayo kunokuba kube ngohlelo.
trading.step_size_body: Usayizi wesikhundla uvela kusabelomali se-ejenti sokuhweba ngakunye, ukhawulelwe isabelomali sayo sansuku zonke kanye nomkhawulo wayo wesikhundla esivulekile. Umvikeli wokusebenzisa kanye nenqubomgomo yesikhwama kuqiniswa kukhodi, ngakho-ke akukho ukulungiselelwa okungakwandisa.

vanity_bounties_index.hard_vanity_addresses_are_hours_to_years: Amakheli e-vanity anzima athatha amahora kuya eminyakeni kumshini owodwa. Lapha ubeka isibambiso USDC (bounty) futhi iqembu labasebenzi abazimele ligaya iphethini yakho ngokufanayo — ofanayo oqinisekisiwe wokuqala uyawina. Hamba uye kuyo, qedela inselele yayo ye-AR, bese isikhwama semali se-ejenti sisayina ubufakazi bokuba khona — okuyinto eqoqekayo engokoqobo, eqinisekiswa ngokuzimela, futhi ebhaliwe nge-cryptography. x402_stripe.a_live_catalog_of_endpoints_an_agent: Ikhathalogi ebukhoma yezindawo zokugcina umenzeli — noma umuntu — angazisebenzisa futhi azikhokhele khona manjalo, zixazululwe ku-chain ku-USDC nge-x402 protocol. Azikho izikhiye, akukho ukubhalisa, akukho SDK okufanele ifundwe. Hlola isikimu, gcwalisa okokufaka, chofoza Run.
x402_stripe.agents_pay_autonomously_with_x402_fetch_: Ama-agent akhokha ngokuzimela nge-@x402/fetch noma i-MCP transport — akukho UI yesikhwama, akukho ukhiye we-API. Izimpahla ezilandiwe kabusha zisekela ukungena kabusha kwe-Sign-In-With-Wallet ukuze abathengi bangalokothi bakhokhe kabili ngento efanayo.
x402_stripe.check_agent_availability_0_001_usdc: <!-- 1. Load once --> <script type="module" src="https://three.ws/x402.js"></script> <!-- 2. Any button becomes a paid call --> <button data-x402-endpoint="https://three.ws/api/x402/symbol-availability?ticker=AGENT" data-x402-merchant="three.ws" data-x402-action="Check ticker availability"> Hlola ukutholakala kwe-AGENT · $0.001 USDC </button>
x402_stripe.const_result_payment_await_window_x402_p: const { result, payment } = await window.X402.pay({ endpoint: '/api/x402/symbol-availability', method: 'GET', body: { ticker: 'AGENT' }, merchant: 'Acme', }); // payment.transaction → on-chain tx hash // payment.payer → buyer wallet // result → your endpoint's JSON response
x402_stripe.every_endpoint_below_is_live_click_one: Zonke iziphetho ezingezansi ziyasebenza. Chofoza eyodwa ukuze uhlole isikimu sayo bese uyisebenzisa ngenkokhelo yangempela eseketheni.
x402_stripe.meta_description: Ikhathalogi ebukhoma yama-API akhokhelwa ngokubiza, axazululwa eseketheni nge-USDC ngaphezu kwephrothokholi ye-x402. Sesha, hlola isikimu, bese usebenzisa noma iyiphi i-endpoint ngokuchofoza okukodwa — azikho izikhiye, akukho ukubhalisa.
x402_stripe.meta_og_description: Ikhathalogi ebukhoma, efuna-funa-kayo yama-API akhokhelwa ngocingo. Hlola i-schema bese usebenzisa noma iyiphi i-endpoint ngokuchofoza okukodwa. Ukukhokhelwa kwe-USDC ku-chain ku-Base naku-Solana.

x402_stripe.paste_one_line_into_your_add_to: Namathisela umugqa owodwa ku-<head> yakho. Faka data-x402-endpoint kunoma iyiphi inkinobho. Imodali iphatha i-wallet, inselele ye-402, nokukhokhelwa.
x402_stripe.payai_or_coinbase_cdp_verifies_and_broad: I-PayAI noma i-Coinbase CDP iqinisekisa futhi isakaze ku-chain. I-endpoint yakho iyasebenza futhi isakaze umphumela emuva.
x402_stripe.phantom_for_solana_metamask_or_coinbase_: I-Phantom ye-Solana, i-MetaMask noma i-Coinbase ye-Base. Sakha ukudluliswa kwe-SPL noma ukugunyazwa kwe-EIP-3009. Ukuchofoza okukodwa.
x402_stripe.same_settlement_driven_from_javascript_t: Ukukhokhelwa okufanayo, okushayelwa yi-JavaScript. Isithembiso sixazulula nge-JSON ye-endpoint yakho kanye nerisidi lokukhokhelwa.
x402_stripe.the_modal_opens_probes_your_endpoint_par: Imodali iyavula, ihlola i-endpoint yakho, ihlaziye inselele ye-402, bese ikhombisa intengo eqondile nenethiwekhi.
x402_stripe.x402_is_http_402_payment_required_with: x402 yi-HTTP 402 Payment Required, enemanifest. Okufakwa kalula kuphatha yonke inqubo — awukaze ukubone.

x402_studio.meta_description: I-Stripe ye-x402. Lungiselela izintengo, ukukhokhelwa nama-wallet ama-agent, imikhiqizo, ukuphepha, i-CORS, ukunikela ngosizo nokusondeza — bese ushicilela isitolo esidonsa-siphose. Konke kukhokhelwa ku-chain ku-USDC.
x402_studio.meta_og_description: Qalisa ibhizinisi le-x402 elikhokhelwayo: ama-wallet ama-agent, imikhiqizo, isitolo esidonsa-siphose, usizo + ukusondeza. Ukukhokhelwa kwe-USDC ku-chain.
x402_studio.meta_twitter_description: I-console yomthengisi yokuqalisa ibhizinisi le-x402 elikhokhelwayo: imikhiqizo nezintengo, ukukhokhelwa nama-wallet ama-agent, ukuthumela/ukwamukela kwe-USDC kwangempela ngokuxazululwa kwe-SNS .sol, isitolo esidonsa-siphose, umakhi wenkinobho yokukhokha efakwayo, usizo nokusondeza, i-CORS nokuphepha.
